# Reltio release process

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s in the box? > What's in the box at a glance > Tenants at a glance > Tenant operation


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/tenants-at-a-glance/tenant-operation/reltio-release-process?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs

**Keywords:** reltio release process, major and bi-weekly releases, preview features in reltio, limited availability offerings, early access offerings, staged tenant deployment process, release schedule across tenants, deprecated features lifecycle, deployment, preview, deprecation, releases, Release Preview, Release schedule


Learn about how Reltio delivers previews, major releases, bi-weekly releases, and staged deployments across your tenants.

Reltio uses a structured release process to deliver new capabilities, enhancements, and fixes across your tenants with minimal disruption. This topic explains how major releases, preview features, Limited Availability, Early Access (EA), bi-weekly releases, and staged deployments across tenants work.

## Major releases

Reltio has two major releases each year, in April and October. In these releases, Reltio introduces new General Availability (GA) features, Limited Availability features or offerings, Early Access (EA) offerings, and major enhancements.

For a list of recent and upcoming major releases, see topic [Release cadence and delivery schedule](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/release-notes-at-a-glance/release-cadence-and-delivery-schedule?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## Preview features

Reltio provides a preview period for specified features before they are officially available as GA in a major release. 

- **Scope**: Previews are for feature-level functionality.
- **Dates**: The Preview period begins before the major GA release date. Reltio communicates these dates in advance so that you can prepare for internal testing and provide feedback.
- **Tenants**: During the preview period, Reltio makes specified new features and enhancements available in Development and Test tenants, but they remain turned off by default. To test a preview feature, turn it on in your Development or Test environment first. Production environments receive these features and enhancements in the GA release, and you can turn them on there when you are ready.
- **Contents**: Reltio holds a Release Overview webinar before a release to describe the new features and enhanced functionality. The Reltio Product Marketing team shares the webinar date and details with the community a few weeks before the release.

## Limited Availability

**Limited Availability** applies to a feature or offering that is included as part of the platform but may be limited by cloud, geography, or planned functionality. The Limited Availability classification will remain in place until those limits are solved. Limited Availability is not a beta or testing program. It meets standard quality standards, receives the same support as a GA production feature, and is available for selective customer and partner use.

## Early Access (EA) features

**Early Access (EA)** applies to new offerings, not features. EA offerings are available to customers and partners who agree to deploy, adopt, and provide feedback on the offering. They may be deployed to Development, Test, and Production environments, although support and availability caveats can apply. The Early Access program enables us to get early feedback from customers, so we can improve the feature functionality, documentation, and logistics such as pricing, infrastructure requirements, and scaling parameters.

The documentation identifies features in the Early Access program. If you are interested in an EA offering, [open a support ticket](https://support.reltio.com/hc/en-us/requests/new) to request access to the EA program.

## Deprecated features

Reltio periodically deprecate older products, features, and services. In certain cases, we replace them with new and improved products. We let you know well in advance when we intend to discontinue or make backward incompatible changes to our products, features, and functionality.

Reltio will use commercially reasonable efforts to continue to operate those identified services, versions, and features without these changes for at least one year after that announcement, unless (as Reltio determines in its reasonable good faith judgment): 

- required by law or third-party relationship (including if there is a change in applicable law or relationship)

  or
- doing so could create a security risk or substantial economic or material technical burden

Find out about features we plan to deprecate in topic [Deprecation Notices at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## Bi-weekly releases

Reltio also delivers bi-weekly releases that include enhancements and required fixes. These releases deliver value faster through smaller changes with consistent quality.

While we deliver these releases every other week, you are in control of what you enable: 

- Learn about new features and fixes in the Release Notes we publish with each release.
- Choose which features or enhancements, such as configurable functionality or backward-compatible API changes, you want to enable at your convenience.

For a list of recent and upcoming bi-weekly releases, see topic [Release cadence and delivery schedule](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/release-notes-at-a-glance/release-cadence-and-delivery-schedule?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## Deployment process

Reltio uses a 3-stage deployment process. Development is stage 1, Test is stage 2, and Production is stage 3. Stage 1 and stage 2 are deployed together.

| Stage | Tenant type | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Development (DEV) & | Every other Friday, from 9 am to 2 pm IST (GMT +5:30) |
| 2 | Test (TEST) | Every other Friday, from 9 am to 2 pm IST (GMT +5:30) |
| 3 | Production (PROD) | The following Friday, from 9 am to 11 am IST (GMT +5:30) |

# Tenant architecture

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s in the box? > What's in the box at a glance > Tenants at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/tenants-at-a-glance/tenant-architecture?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs

**Keywords:** Reltio cloud architecture, customer's MDM tenant, within Reltio cloud, customer tenant, data tenant, tenant architecture


Learn where tenants site in Reltio Context Intelligence Platform architecture.

Reltio cloud-based customer tenants sit on your organization's preferred cloud provider. In the Reltio layered MDM model, your tenant is your [Reltio L3 layer](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/what-does-reltio-do/what-reltio-does-at-a-glance/data-unification-and-mdm-at-a-glance/data-unification-and-mdm-in-detail/reltio-information-model/data-model/tenant-configuration-inheritance-across-layers/reltio-l3-layer----customer-tenant?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs). That's the level you configure and provision.

In Reltio Context Intelligence Platform architecture, customer tenants contain:

- 

  Application-level configuration

  This is where you access Reltio applications, APIs, and resources to configure the platform's appearance and behavior, including which external data sources it connects to and how it manages interactions, transactions, relationships, and reference data.
- 

  Business data

  This is where your organization's data is matched, merged, cleansed, curated, governed, linked, and made available to downstream systems such as customer relationship management, order management, and compliance.

Each tenant (Dev, Test, and Prod) comes preconfigured with:

**[Reltio velocity packs](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/tenants-at-a-glance/tenant-architecture/reltio-velocity-packs?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)**

Prepackaged support for a market segment that supports your organization's business objectives. The Dev tenant is additionally provisioned with a small set of sample data designed to illustrate the use of the out-of-the-box application.

**Queues**

Allocated and linked to an AWS SQS queue to receive events from the tenant. This conveniently enables message-queue style of integrations with other systems in your enterprise.

**Reference Data Management (RDM)**

Accompanied by and logically linked to a Reference Data Management (RDM) tenant. The RDM tenant is pre-configured with reference data supportive of the Solution Accelerator pre-configured on the MDM tenants.

**Storage space**

Accompanied by a bucket in AWS S3 where you can place data files and perform file manipulations. The bucket serves as a convenient folder in the Reltio Context Intelligence Platform where applications can retrieve and place files for data loading and extraction. Sometimes, you may want to place extracts from on-premises systems into this folder for easy access by integration tools.

**Tenant cloning and snapshot services**

Support for additional clones and snapshots, with the option to purchase more.

**Data as a Service (add-on)**

Pre-integration to third-party data tenants from providers of commercially available reference and enrichment data using Reltio's DTSS (Data Tenant Subscription Service) technology if your Reltio Platform license includes the use of Reltio Context Intelligence Platform 's Data as a Service integration to a Reltio platform Data Tenant.

The following topics in this section explain more about these tenant components. For details on the components and resources available on tenants, see section [About applications](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/about-applications?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# AWS access key and secret in favor of IAM roles for Reltio-owned resources

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Deprecation Notices at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/aws-access-key-and-secret-in-favor-of-iam-roles-for-reltio-owned-resources?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about the upcoming deprecation of AWS access key and secret authentication and the transition to IAM AssumeRole-based authentication.

As part of our continuous effort to enhance the security, availability, and efficiency of the Reltio Context Intelligence Platform, we are transitioning from AWS access key and secret authentication to IAM role-based authentication using [AssumeRole](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/API_AssumeRole.html) for Reltio-owned AWS resources. This change aligns with the latest security best practices, which recommend using IAM roles over long-term credentials to improve security, reduce credential exposure, and enable better access management.

> **Note:** We are continuously improving this topic to provide clearer guidance and a smoother transition experience. While IAM roles are the recommended authentication method going forward, there is currently no deprecation date set for existing integrations using AWS access keys and secrets. Expect updates to enhance clarity and usability, including a deprecation timeline when one is finalized.

## What are we deprecating?

We are deprecating the use of AWS access key and secret authentication for accessing our services. Instead, you should authenticate with IAM roles using AssumeRole, which provides temporary security credentials and eliminate the risks associated with long-lived access keys.

## Why are we deprecating it?

Best practices on cross-account AWS authentication highlights the security risks of long-term access keys and recommends IAM roles as the best practice for secure authentication. IAM roles provide temporary credentials that are automatically rotated, reducing the likelihood of credential leakage and unauthorized access. This transition enhances the security and resilience of the Reltio Context Intelligence Platform.

## When are we deprecating it?

We are notifying you in advance that AWS access key and secret authentication will be deprecated in the future. **No deprecation date has been set for existing integrations at this time**. However, we strongly recommend beginning the transition to IAM roles as soon as possible to ensure a smooth migration.

## What does this mean to you?

If you are currently using AWS access key and secret authentication to access a Reltio service, you should begin transitioning to IAM role-based authentication. This change ensures compliance with AWS security best practices and improves the security of your integrations.

## What action do you need to take?

**For customers using AWS access key and secrets to access Reltio-owned AWS resources**

Update your authentication mechanism to use IAM role-based authentication. Ensure that your applications can assume the necessary IAM roles for accessing Reltio services. For guidance, see

- Export service: [Secure export AWS authentication](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/load-and-export-apis/load-and-export-apis-at-a-glance/export-service-apis/secure-export-aws-authentication?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
- Match service: [External match API - AWS](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/entity-management-apis/entity-management-apis-at-a-glance/potential-matches-api/external-match-api---aws?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
- Data streaming: [Add an external queue configuration](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/stream-data/data-streaming-at-a-glance/data-streaming-operation/add-an-external-queue-configuration?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
- Life Cycle Actions with AWS Lambda: [LCA as AWS Lambda: Identity and Access Management](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/about-developer-resources/developer-resources-at-a-glance/customize-data-tasks-with-lcas/lca-deployment-using-aws-lambda/lca-as-aws-lambda-identity-and-access-management?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)

**For customers already using IAM roles**

No action is required. You are already following the AWS recommended approach.

## Still have questions?

[Get help in Support Portal](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) if you need assistance transitioning to IAM roles or have specific questions about how this change impacts your environment.

# Classic UI - Feb 2023

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Deprecation Notices at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/classic-ui---feb-2023?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about switching from the classic user interface (UI) to the new and improved UI.

Say goodbye to the Classic user interface (UI).

As announced during the **Reltio Connected Data Platform 2022.2 Release**, Reltio plans to retire the Classic UI on 22 February, 2023.

## What are we deprecating?

We're deprecating the classic user interface in the **Hub**, which includes the **Dashboard**, the **Profile** view and all perspectives under the **Profile** view.

## Why are we deprecating it?

The Reltio Connected Data Platform now boasts a superior and improved user interface! The new UI provides a more intuitive experience, delivers innovations faster, and provides users with enhanced performance. Some of the key benefits of the new UI are: 

- Quickly navigate through our modernized interface, simplifying the data stewards's experience of managing data.
- Easily understand entities and relationships using our new match and graph visualizations.
- Efficiently manage the match and merge process through the enhanced potential match views.

## When are we deprecating it?

We're deprecating the classic user interface on 22 February 2023.

## What does this mean to you?

There will be no impact if you're already using the new user interface. If you're using the classic user interface, you'll automatically move to the new user interface once it's deprecated.

## What action do you need to take?

No action is required from your side. The switch will happen automatically for anyone still using the Classic user interface. You can switch to the new user interface anytime before we retire the classic user interface. We strongly recommend you to make the switch now. 

> **Note:** If you are a new customer, you will only see the new UI. If you are an existing customer, you can choose to use the new UI any time you want. All new features will be available only in the new UI and only critical bugs will be fixed in the classic UI until it is deprecated.

## Still have questions?

[Get help in Support Portal](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# Reltio Analytics, Reporting, Data Science, and Connected Data for Snowflake deprecation notice - Nov 2023

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Deprecation Notices at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/reltio-analytics-reporting-data-science-and-connected-data-for-snowflake-deprecation-notice---nov-2023?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs

**Keywords:** Reltio Analytics, Connected Data for Snowflake, Reltio Data Science, Reltio Reporting, Legacy connectors deprecation notice ready for review


Learn how to migrate from legacy to new Analytics, Reporting, Data Science and Snowflake products.

Get ready to forge new connections.

At Reltio, we periodically deprecate older products, features, and services. In certain cases, we replace them with new and improved products. We plan to deprecate the legacy products listed in this topic in November 2023. We're offering you migration paths from these legacy products to new and improved replacement products that are available now.

## What are we deprecating?

We're deprecating these legacy products

- 

  Reltio Analytics
- 

  Reltio Reporting
- 

  Data Science (RDS)
- 

  Legacy Reltio Connected Data for Snowflake

## When are we deprecating them?

## What kind of support can we expect before this deprecation date?

We will continue to provide support for routine maintenance and quality assurance on current operational features as well as emergency bug fixes for issues that occur in your production environments. The support escalation procedures will stay the same. However, we won't make any more enhancements or improvements to these products from 30-Nov-2022 onward.

## Why are we deprecating them?

We refactored our architecture to enhance data consistency, performance, and security features that these legacy products couldn't offer or guarantee to customers.

We have designed potential replacement products to:

- 

  Enhance the most critical data security, consistency, and performance features requested by customers within their current products.
- 

  Implement additional features that significantly improve speed, accuracy, and monitoring.
- 

  Provide features to support backwards compatibility and help ease customer migration efforts.

## What are we replacing them with?

The new and improved replacement products are:

- 

  **Reltio Snowflake Connector**
- 

  **Reltio Google BigQuery (GBQ) Connector**

## How are the new connectors different?

We are using a new architectural approach to develop high-performance connectors. The new connectors stream data in a near real-time fashion, so there are no issues with data consistency.

These connectors are purpose built to deliver Reltio data into customer-managed analytics systems and provide compatible data structures that you won't have to create or manage.

These new connectors will give you more control over security and administration processes to manage your analytics warehouse environments. You can take care of various self-service tasks, such as adding a new user or increasing performance parameters, by yourself without needing to contact Reltio Support.

## Are these new products production-ready now?

Yes, the new Reltio for Snowflake and GBQ Connectors are GA and ready for production.

## What replacement products do we recommend?

Here are our specific product recommendations for each specific legacy product. Contact your CSM to coordinate with the Reltio Product team for specific guidance on available or planned product replacements.

|  | Recommended Alternatives | Recommended Alternatives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Deprecated product | (available now) | (available later) |
| **Reltio Analytics**  **Reltio Reporting** | -     Reltio Snowflake Connector -     Reltio Google BigQuery Connector | -     Reltio Snowflake Connector      -     Reltio Google BigQuery Connector |
| **Reltio Connected Data for Snowflake** | - Reltio Snowflake Connector | -     Reltio Snowflake Connector |
| **Reltio Data Science** | -     Reltio Data Science (Databricks-hosted as of 03-Aug-2022) -     Reltio Snowflake Connector -     Reltio Google BigQuery Connector | -     Reltio Databricks Connector      -     Reltio Snowflake Connector      -     Reltio Google BigQuery Connector |

## Do the new connectors provide OOTB Reltio reports?

The majority of legacy out-of-the-box (OOTB) reports offered in **Reltio Reporting** are now available for display and configuration in the new Reltio UI. However, we realize there is a need for more extensive reporting capabilities for our analytics customers.

The new connector products will include a reporting feature that offers you the ability to build your own Reltio data reports using the native business intelligence (BI) tools that Google BigQuery and Snowflake offer: Google Studio and Snowsight.

## What backwards compatibility do the new products offer?

The products can be configured to represent the same tables/views that display the majority of the Reltio data types that the legacy products currently support.This is to prevent customer rework for customer analysis or workstreams derived from legacy products, such as reports based on legacy **Reltio Analytics** GBQ tables.

Reltio Workflow and Activity Log data types will be available by 21-Jun-23 to address any additional migration needs you may have.

## How will the migration process work?

Reltio will engage its support team and/or external partners to assist with the majority of migration efforts, by default. Reltio's product and engineering team will work behind the scenes to ensure success. Customers need to allocate at least 1-2 internal staff members to coordinate with internal partners to plan the migration from the customer's perspective, provide requested inputs for Reltio to perform the migration, and validate the migration results. If requested, Reltio can also provide an option to accelerate the migration by using its Professional Services team.

## How long will the migration take?

The average migration timeline is 12 weeks and is primarily dependent on customer involvement, participation, and needs to accelerate or decelerate the timeline.

Reltio can offer its professional services team to accelerate the migration timeline based on customer needs. With Reltio's Professional Services involved, the timeline would be scoped out with the customer. Please contact your Reltio CSM for more details.

## Do I have to stop my existing products during the migration?

No, you can set up and tune the new connector products in parallel with existing product operations. The migration process will not affect how your current products are running today. In fact, as part of the migration process, we can specify validation steps to compare current products to the new ones if desired.

## How much do the new alternative products cost?

Please contact your CSM for product pricing and migration details.

## What happens if I choose not to migrate?

To clarify your question and understand all the details needed to make this decision, we recommend you contact your CSM to coordinate a session with the Reltio Product team. Reltio wants to provide the best path forward for you to ensure a seamless transition. In the event that our offered migration path does not work best for you, we suggest that you plan accordingly to enable other options before the 30-Nov-2023 deprecation date.

## Still have questions?

If you need more information about the migration process and product roadmap for these new connectors, contact your CSM. Your CSM can advise next steps and coordinate with the appropriate Reltio teams to start the migration process and provide product roadmap details for our new offerings.

# Data Loader feature deprecation - Apr, Jun, and Oct 2024

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Deprecation Notices at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/data-loader-feature-deprecation---apr-jun-and-oct-2024?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about the Data Loader features being deprecated from tenants on the different cloud platforms.

We're improving the Console Data Loader, for tenants deployed on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). As part of that, we're deprecating some features.

## What are we deprecating?

We're deprecating these Console Data Loader features:

- 

  The **Analysis** tab in **Job status** page.

  *Image: dn-dl-aws-apr2024.png*

  > **Note:** On April 19, 2024, we announced plans to deprecate the Data Loader's ability to merge multiple records into a single entity during preprocessing. We've decided to make that functionality optional. It's enabled by default, but you can disable it when you define a Data Loader job.

## Why are we deprecating it?

The data provided in the **Analysis** tab of the **Job status** page is available in the Real-Time Data Quality dashboard time-series charts, where you can more fully analyze the kind of data you loaded. For more information, see topic [Real-Time Data Quality dashboard charts](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/monitor-data-quality/data-quality-monitoring-at-a-glance/data-quality-monitoring-reference/real-time-data-quality-dashboard-charts?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

On April 19, 2024, we announced the deprecation of the Data Loader functionality that merges multiple records into one entity during preprocessing. Your feedback convinced us that we should keep it in! Instead of deprecating it, we're making this Data Loader functionality optional, from June 10, 2024. For more information, see topic [Create one entity from multiple records](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/load-and-export-data/data-loading-at-a-glance/data-loading-operation/load-data-with-data-loader/load-entities-into-a-tenant/create-one-entity-from-multiple-records?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## When are we deprecating it?

We're deprecating these Console Data Loader features on these dates: 

- 

  April 15, 2024: any new tenants provisioned on the AWS cloud
- 

  June 17, 2024: existing tenants previously provisioned on the AWS cloud
- 

  October 14, 2024: existing or new tenants provisioned on the Azure and GCP cloud

## What does this mean to you?

After these dates, the deprecated features will no longer be available: 

- 

  Instead of the **Analysis** tab on the Data Loader, use the functionality in the Real-Time Data Quality Dashboard.
- 

  Instead of deprecating the Data Loader's ability to merge multiple records into a single entity during preprocessing, as announced April 19, 2024, we've instead made, it optional. If you relied on this functionality, you can continue to do so. To avoid disruption, we've enabled it by default; you can disable it when you define a Data Loader job.

## What action do you need to take?

No action is required from your side. Reltio automatically implements this change on your tenant.

## Still have questions?

If you're an existing customer using the Reltio Connected Data Platform, you'll receive an email about this deprecation. For any other questions, contact the [Reltio Customer Engineering team.](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# Deprecation Notices at a glance

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Take it from the top with Deprecation Notices. Get the overview here, then see the sub topics in this section to drill down to the details.

## What are Deprecation Notices?

Deprecation Notices advise you of products and features we plan to discontinue in Reltio Context Intelligence Platform. Notices may mention Reltio Connected Data Platform, Reltio Connected Cloud, or Reltio Connected Customer 360 as that was the name of our platform at the time.

Reltio announces if we intend to discontinue or make backward-incompatible changes to our products, services, and APIs:

**Deprecation policy**

Reltio will use commercially reasonable efforts to continue to operate those services, versions and features identified without these changes for at least one year after that announcement, unless (as Reltio determines in its reasonable good faith judgment):

- 

  required by law or third-party relationship (including if there is a change in applicable law or relationship)

  or
- 

  doing so could create a security risk or substantial economic or material technical burden

**Discontinuance of services and API**

Reltio may discontinue any API, Services or any portion or feature for any reason at any time without liability to the customers.

## Who are Deprecation Notices for?

This content is curated for all Reltio user roles defined in topic [About roles](https://docs.reltio.com/en/roles/about-roles?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs):

Business UserData Product OwnerData StewardDeveloperReltio ConfiguratorSolution ArchitectSystem Administrator

## Why would I use Deprecation Notices?

Read Deprecation Notices to find out about plans to remove existing products and features from Reltio Context Intelligence Platform. We provide clear details on why and when we'll deprecate them along with steps you need to take and any replacements you can use.

## When would I use Deprecation Notices?

Reltio provides as much warning as possible before turning off features or products. Check here routinely to be aware of any such changes.

## Where do I find Deprecation Notices?

From the Documentation Portal home page, select **What's new and notable > Deprecation notices**.

# Match IQ - Feb 2026

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Deprecation Notices at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/match-iq---feb-2026?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about the Match IQ feature being deprecated.

Match IQ is a machine learning (ML)-driven matching solution that enables you to build and refine your own ML models through an active learning process. You interact with the system by answering questions to identify match pairs, allowing the model to continuously improve its accuracy.

## What are we deprecating?

The Match IQ feature, a ML-based matching solution.

## Why are we deprecating it?

We hear you! We understood that many of you found the active learning process required to train the Match IQ model too time-consuming to implement. You didn't want to answer the large number of questions required to train the model. We also know that those of you who have trained the Match IQ model haven't found it to be more effective than creating and deploying rules for your matching scenarios.

## When are we deprecating it?

We will deprecate this feature on February 16, 2026.

## What does this mean to you?

If you are currently using the Match IQ feature, you'll need to migrate to an alternative matching solution before February 16, 2026.

## Still have questions?

If you use this feature, you should receive an email. For more information, contact Reltio Support, see topic [Get help in Support Portal](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# Monitoring Statistics – June 2025

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Deprecation Notices at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/monitoring-statistics--june-2025?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about the deprecation of the Monitoring Statistics page in Tenant Management.

**Monitoring Statistics**, within the **Tenant Management** app, provides an overview of basic tenant-level usage metrics. This feature is being phased out in favor of the enhanced **Usage Reporting** app, which offers broader insights, a modern interface, and better support for analysis.

## What are we deprecating?

The **Monitoring Statistics** page in the **Tenant Management** app.

## Why are we deprecating it?

We’ve introduced the **Usage Reporting** app to provide you with a more robust and user-friendly experience. Unlike the **Monitoring Statistics** page, the new app includes improved filtering, trend visualization, and exportable data — enabling deeper analysis and actionable insights.

## When are we deprecating it?

We will deprecate this feature on June 9, 2025.

## What does this mean to you?

The Monitoring Statistics page will no longer be accessible after the deprecation date. If you rely on this page, we encourage you to start using the **Usage Reporting** app. A banner on the existing page will guide you to the new experience. If you can't access the **Usage Reporting** app, please raise a support ticket with us.

## What about the Tenant Health Status indicator?

The **Tenant Health Status** indicator currently shown on the **Monitoring Statistics** page will also be removed. This facet reflects only internal queue activity and does not accurately represent overall tenant health.

For accurate insights into queue activity and size, we recommend using the [Queue Monitoring Dashboard](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/tenant-management-applications/tenant-management-at-a-glance/queues-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) in the **Tenant Management** app. 

> **Note:** The underlying [Status API](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/status-api?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) that powers this indicator will continue to be supported.

## Still have questions?

If you use this feature, you’ll see an in-app notification. For more information, contact Reltio Support. See [Reltio Support](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# Native LCA deprecation – Oct 2025 and Aug 2026

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Deprecation Notices at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/native-lca-deprecation--oct-2025-and-aug-2026?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about the phased deprecation of native LCAs and what it means for your tenants.

## What are we deprecating?

We're deprecating the native Lifecycle Action (LCA) feature in two phases. Native LCAs are customer-authored code that currently run in Reltio’s environment. This deprecation applies to all tenants and includes changes to how new and existing native LCAs are supported.

This change affects the entire native LCA framework, including the ability to create, update, deploy, and run LCAs hosted in Reltio-managed infrastructure. Once deprecated, Reltio will no longer host or execute any customer-authored native LCAs, regardless of their deployment history.

## Why are we deprecating it?

Native LCAs run in Reltio’s environment but are authored by customers. This can lead to performance or security issues, since the code isn't owned by Reltio. Poorly performing native LCAs can also impact other tenants hosted on the same node.

To reduce these risks, Reltio engineering manually reviews and approves all native LCAs before deployment. This manual review process creates delays for customers and increases engineering dependence.

## When are we deprecating it?

This change is happening in two stages: 

- 

  **October 24, 2025:** New native LCAs can no longer be deployed or hosted.
- 

  **August 31, 2026:** Support for the native LCA feature ends entirely.

## What does this mean to you?

- 

  If you have existing native LCAs, you can continue using and updating them until August 31, 2026.
- 

  After that date, native LCAs will no longer function or be supported.

## What action do you need to take?

You're encouraged to migrate your native LCAs to cloud-native functions hosted in your own environment: 

- 

  **AWS Lambda**
- 

  **Google Cloud Functions**
- 

  **Azure Functions**

Reltio will provide automated scripts, detailed documentation, and transition support. The goal is to make migration require minimal effort from your team.

Also, any new LCAs should be created only as cloud native functions.

## Still have questions?

Customers using native LCAs will receive an email notification. For help or further details, contact the [Reltio Customer Engineering team](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# Internal API sign in service - Oct 2023

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Deprecation Notices at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/internal-api-sign-in-service---oct-2023?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about the new API authentication service that replaces the internal one.

Say goodbye to the `POST /services/oauth/token` service.

Reltio plans to retire the internal API service used to log into the tenant.

## What are we deprecating?

We're deprecating the `POST /services/oauth/token` API service, which some customers use to authenticate their integration services and processes.

## Why are we deprecating it?

The API service, intended for Reltio Internal Services, was designed for the classic UI. Now that we've deprecated the Classic UI, we're also saying goodbye to this service.

## When are we deprecating it?

We're deprecating the service on October 16, 2023, as part of our 2023.3 GA release.

## What does this mean to you?

You will no longer be able to use this authentication service for any script or integration process.

## What action do you need to take?

Switch your login endpoints to use the `https://auth.reltio.com/oauth/token` service before the deprecation date. For more information about this service, see topic [Obtaining an Access Token with Password Grant Type](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/authentication-api/obtaining-an-access-token-with-password-grant-type?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## Still have questions?

If you are using this sign in service, you will receive an email about the deprecation. # US Census replaced with Census Plus - Sep 2024

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Deprecation Notices at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/us-census-replaced-with-census-plus---sep-2024?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about 2010 US Census data fields deprecation.

Say goodbye to US Census fields and hello to US Census Plus ones.

Reltio plans to retire US Census 2010 dataset fields from the Reltio Address Cleanser, replacing those fields with US Census 2020 dataset fields, also known as Census Plus.

## What are we deprecating?

We are deprecating these US Census 2010 dataset fields:

- 

  CBSAMetropolitanStatisticalArea
- 

  CBSAMicropolitanStatisticalArea
- 

  MetropolitanDivision
- 

  NECTADivision
- 

  NECTAMetropolitanStatisticalArea
- 

  NECTAMicropolitanStatisticalArea

For more details on the differences between the Census datasets, see topic [US Census Plus data fields](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-reference/out-of-the-box-cleanse-functions/address-cleanser/enhanced-data/us-census-plus-data/us-census-plus-data-fields?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## Why are we deprecating it?

Beginning with its Q3 2022 major release, Loqate updated the dataset used for address data enrichment with U.S. Census Plus data, including both format and values. Loqate switched from 2010 to 2020 Census data to deliver the most up-to-date information to customers. Reltio maintained backwards compatibility with the older data format when adopting the new dataset, to limit the immediate impact on customers who were already using this feature. We are working to eliminate the redundant, older format from our Address Cleanser.

## When are we deprecating it?

We're deprecating the US Census fields on September 30, 2024.

## What does this mean to you?

You will no longer be able to use deprecated Census fields from the 2010 format, adopting the improved format with richer data.

## What action do you need to take?

If you are using the deprecated fields from the Census dataset, you must upgrade your tenant business configuration and any other integrated components in order to continue to use the corresponding, upgraded fields in the Census Plus dataset. Learn how to topic [Enable US Census Plus data](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-reference/out-of-the-box-cleanse-functions/address-cleanser/enhanced-data/us-census-plus-data/enable-us-census-plus-data?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## Still have questions?

If you're using 2010 US Census data, you'll receive an email about the deprecation of these fields. For any other questions, contact [Reltio Support](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# UUID format for ≤60-minute authentication tokens - Apr 2024

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Deprecation Notices at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/uuid-format-for-60-minute-authentication-tokens---apr-2024?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about the use of JWT for access tokens with an expiration of 60 minutes or less.

As part of our continuous effort to improve the security, availability, and efficiency of the Reltio Connected Data Platform, we are updating our authentication scheme to exclusively use JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for access tokens that expire within 60 minutes. Effective from April 9, 2024, the Authentication service will respond to API token requests in the JWT format.

## What are we deprecating?

For all users and clients configured with a token expiration period of 60 minutes or less, we are deprecating the Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) access token format. Instead, the Authentication service will provide access tokens in the JWT format. We are not changing how you request access tokens, we are only changing the format of the response.

## Why are we deprecating it?

JWT enables our platform's microservices to operate with far fewer calls to the Authentication service. This will reduce latency by up to 50 ms for most user-facing Reltio API calls. Additionally, reducing reliance on the authentication service improves the platform's overall availability.

## When are we deprecating it?

Starting April 9, 2024, we are gradually switching the authentication tokens to JWT tokens across all customers.

## What does this mean to you?

Most customers will see no impact from this change and will not need to take any action. Including if you use Reltio APIs via Postman. However, if you are consuming the Reltio `Authentication API` using a custom-coded parser to parse the current token from the authentication request, you will need to change your parsing logic to accommodate JWT tokens, which are longer than our current tokens.

**Before - UUID access token**

```
{
  "access_token": "xxxxx-xxxx-xxx-xxx-xxxx",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "refresh_token": "xxxxx-xxxx-xxx-xxx-xxxx",
  "expires_in": 3598,
  "scope": "entities_api graphs_api  interactions_api relations_api "
}
```

**After - JWT access token**

```
{
  "access_token": "s.AAAApCi1L_0gpC0EALJIHR9gtc4YCK5QDQMndHHZ6JEtSuAIK6RUrP_4GmAIguUCkznECazMCRSkOaMde7T-MORJFOgSp731Bs9bBvPYUqDT1nE0jmFGe6fWl6XwLq3H6fAu1zlntUdXe8B6AmqKiEDBaUAiChkjAOO8T-tQlCQ0vDdXAQQAi0wSkRr8yyz5NZ8.HzCVd5EXWmKgs1nWbRnXCWMBpidCChPunOKAw02lnH9q3y0LNsIwYSmxhxK4eb3Mf7LM70edWZ1dbHxAR3crWb-uIOcDWf6UdGJuqna2wz5S0FbED6ijmd9bdXqhJ5gCIIDkMcy5VpUVoeVsn_DDOfbRMsrWWVuOaoP3BvRy-BtvWwsrnEwEAfg_G5aEGcBhu4WkKPC2VCejC2rQw8A__nFkEWK3oUDDJEp_75_uvwfY5Y965ubyqNKAdRZF9orjh1ZdkJCPJ1IaacAytGQ6mPzv8il4r9NrFsnCfOZ-52oPY9Qxi-ccffasd-w",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "refresh_token": "xxxxx-xxxx-xxx-xxx-xxxx",
  "expires_in": 3598,
  "scope": "entities_api graphs_api interactions_api relations_api"
}
```

## What action do you need to take?

**For users of custom parsers**

If you rely on a custom-coded parser for token authentication, we strongly recommend you change to a standard JSON parser. For example, [google.gson](https://github.com/google/gson) or[python.json](https://docs.python.org/3/library/json.html). Let us know if you want to discuss your specific scenario or need a hand changing your client's configuration to adopt the JWT format. For information, see topic [Reltio Support](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**For custom implementations that depend on token size or format**

If your custom implementation depends on the size of the token or restricts it in some way, by length or format, the implementation may not be compatible with the new JWT token format. The new format tokens have a size up to 3Kb (3.000 characters long) and won't be in a UUID format anymore.

**Token expiration settings**

If your client's token expiration period is set to more than 60 minutes, consider reconfiguring to 60 minutes or less to use JWT. You set the expiration period with the `accessTokenValidity` parameter in your client configuration, see topic [Create a customer client](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/authentication-api/application-client-management-apis/create-a-customer-client?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)

## Still have questions?

Contact Reltio Support and we'll discuss your specific scenario. For more information, see topic [Reltio Support](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# Custom workflow manual review replaced with automated Bitbucket process - Feb 2025

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Deprecation Notices at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/custom-workflow-manual-review-replaced-with-automated-bitbucket-process---feb-2025?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about the transition from a manual to an automated Bitbucket process to review customer workflow jars.

This notice covers a change in how you get your custom workflow jars reviewed, transitioning from a manual to an automated process.

## What are we deprecating?

The manual process for reviewing custom workflow jars will be discontinued starting February 10, 2025.

## Why are we deprecating it?

We're making this change to streamline operations, improve efficiency, and offer a faster, more reliable review experience. The automated Bitbucket approval process reduces the need for manual intervention while enhancing scalability and reliability.

## When are we deprecating it?

The manual review process will no longer be supported after **February 10, 2025**.

## What does this mean to you?

After the deprecation date, all custom workflow jar reviews will need to go through the automated Bitbucket approval process. Manual reviews will no longer be available.

## What action do you need to take?

To prepare for this transition:

- Start using the automated Bitbucket approval process for custom workflow jar reviews.
- If you need help during the transition, reach out to your Customer Success Manager (CSM).
- Review the following resources for guidance:
  - [Configure custom workflows](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/manage-workflow-tasks/workflow-management-at-a-glance/workflow-management-set-up/overview-of-workflow-customizations/overview-of-workflow-configuration/configure-custom-workflows?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
  - [Workflow FAQ](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/manage-workflow-tasks/workflow-management-at-a-glance/workflow-management-reference/workflow-faq?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)

## Still have questions?

If you're using this process, you should receive an email notification about the change. For specific issues, [Get help in Support Portal](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# Reltio Address Cleanser update - Sep 2024

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Platform changes at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/reltio-address-cleanser-update---sep-2024?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about the updates to the Reltio Address Cleanser in September 2024

Here are the updates to the [Reltio Address Cleanser](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-reference/out-of-the-box-cleanse-functions/address-cleanser?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) in September 2024.

## Postal Code Support Updates

Countries with updated postal code formats and improvements in address validation include:

- Israel: Improved postal code precision with support for 7-digit postal code.
- Taiwan: Improved validation for 6-digit postal codes and locality accuracy.
- Türkiye: Updated to reflect the latest output address format and the official country name change from Turkey to Türkiye.

## Country Rebuilds

Major rebuilds have been performed for the following countries:

- Türkiye: Updated with the latest country name and address format changes, including improvements to the postal code system.
- United States: A new data source was added to improve address validation accuracy and provide better coverage.

## Global Data Refreshes

Data has been refreshed in the following countries to ensure the latest available address information is reflected: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Benin, Brazil, Burundi, Canada, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, Estonia, Eswatini, Finland, France, Germany, Great Britain, Greece, Guernsey, Hong Kong, Hungary, Iceland, India, Ireland, Isle of Man, Israel, Italy, Jersey, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Mali, Malta, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Puerto Rico, Romania, Sao Tome and Principe, Saudi Arabia, Serbia, Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, South Africa, South Korea , South Sudan, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Tonga, Türkiye, United Arab Emirates, and the United States of America.

## Address Parsing Enhancements

The following countries have received improvements in address parsing and validation:

- Canada: Enhanced parsing for thoroughfares and locality names, particularly in Québec, including improvements for address validation in cases with typos.
- France: Improved address structure validation and better handling of localized address components.
- Germany: Improved thoroughfare verification, showing enhanced address validation in cases where specific thoroughfares were previously misidentified.
- Greece: Enhanced address verification for specific localities to improve accuracy in identifying correct postal regions.
- Denmark: Corrected sub-building output format, ensuring more accurate representation of sub-building addresses.

# Reltio Address Cleanser update - Nov 2024

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Platform changes at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/reltio-address-cleanser-update---nov-2024?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about the updates to the Reltio Address Cleanser in November 2024

Here are the updates to the [Reltio Address Cleanser](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-reference/out-of-the-box-cleanse-functions/address-cleanser?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) in November 2024.

## Verification process improvements

These are the improvements:

- Matching of empty fields which reduces the number of ambiguous results.
- Matching of ranged fields' prefix is now case insensitive.
- For the US, returning PostalCodeSecondary for US addresses to enable verification at Level 4 and Level 5.

## Address parsing fixes

Countries with fixes in address parsing and validation:

- Brazil: Improved PostalCode verification.
- Canada: Improved parsing for SubBuilding.
- Czech Republic: Corrected the parsing of premise.
- Germany: Corrected the Germany Address Format.

  | Before | After |
  | --- | --- |
  | Default:  Line 1 \| Organization  Line 2 \| Building SubBuilding  Line 3 \| Thoroughfare Premise  Line 4 \| PostalCode Locality | Default:  Line 1 \| Organization  Line 2 \| Thoroughfare Premise  Line 3 \| Building SubBuilding  Line 4 \| PostalCode Locality  If postbox is provided, then:  Line 1 \| Organization  Line 2 \| PostBox  Line 3 \| PostalCode Locality |
- Great Britain: Improved Geo Accuracy level.
- Ireland: Improved output address format.
- Netherlands: Added pattern to identify 40-3rd floor as a Premise.
- United States: Improved parsing for thoroughfare.

## Postal code fixes

These countries had fixes:

- Brazil:
  - PostalCode '11030-230' is now under Locality 'Santos' only.
  - Invalid PostalCode '28473-970' is no longer in the data.
- United States:
  - PostalCode '13056' is now under Locality 'East Homer' only.

## Country Rebuilds

A rebuild was performed for Brazil (BR) to improve the Address Verification Code (AVC).

## Global data refreshes

These countries had a data refresh: Afghanistan (AF), Argentina (AR), Australia (AU), Austria (AT), Bonaire Sint Eustatius and Saba (BQ), Bulgaria (BG), Burkina Faso (BF), Canada (CA), Chile (CL), Colombia (CO), Czech Republic (CZ), Denmark (DK), Ecuador (EC), Egypt (EG), Eswatini (SZ), Finland (FI), France (FR), Gabon (GA), Germany (DE), Guernsey (GG), Hong Kong (HK), Isle of Man (IM), Israel (IL), Jersey (JE), Macao (MO), Mali (ML), Netherlands (NL), New Zealand (NZ), Norway (NO), Puerto Rico (PR), Saint Barthelemy (BL), Saint Kitts and Nevis (KN), Singapore (SG), South Korea (KR), Spain (ES), Suriname (SR), Switzerland (CH), Taiwan (TW), United Arab Emirates (AE), United Kingdom (GB), United States (US), Vietnam (VN).

## Global data refreshes

These countries had a data refresh: Argentina (AR), Australia (AU), Austria (AT), Belgium (BL), Bermuda (BR), Canada (CA), Chile (CL), Colombia (CO), Croatia (HR), Czech Republic (CZ), Denmark (DK), Dominican Republic (DO), Ecuador (EC), Estonia (EE), Finland (FI), France (FR), Germany (DE), Greece (GR), Guernsey (GG), Hong Kong (HK), Hungary (HU), Iceland (IS), India (IN), Indonesia (ID), Ireland (IE), Isle Of Man (IM), Jersey (JE), Liechtenstein (LI), Lithuania (LT), Luxembourg (LU), Macao (MO), Malaysia (MY), Malta (MT), Mexico (MX), Netherlands (NL), New Zealand (NZ), Norway (NO), Philippines (PH), Poland (PL), Portugal (PT), Puerto Rico (PR), Romania (RO), Saint Barthelemy (BM), Serbia (RS), Singapore (SG), Slovakia (SK), Slovenia (SI), South Korea (KR), Suriname (SR), Sweden (SE), Taiwan (TW), Thailand (TH), Tonga (TO), United Arab Emirates (AE), United Kingdom (GB), United States (US).

## Geographic Data Hierarchy updates

## Country Rebuilds

Major rebuild for:

- Bulgaria (BG): General improvement in Thoroughfare parsing and verification.
- France (FR): Country rebuild with updated data source and geographic hierarchy corrections.
- Chile (CL): Country rebuild with improved reference data.
- Ecuador (EC): Country rebuild to enhance regional accuracy.

## Data case improvements and fixes

Case-specific parsing and verification improvements and fixes for:

- Brazil (BR): Improved output of PostalCode.
- Canada (CA): Corrected Building value, Organization parsing, and AdministrativeArea for Calgary.
- Greece (GR): Improved Locality verification.
- India (IN): Corrected Building value.
- Ireland (IE): Improved Thoroughfare and PostTown parsing; AVC matchscore fix.
- Japan (JP): Corrected Thoroughfare and PostalCode parsing.
- Mexico (MX): Added PostalCode to localities including Aguascalientes.
- Netherlands (NL): Improved Street parsing.
- Philippines (PH): Corrected Postal Code value.
- Portugal (PT): Improved Geocodes.
- Romania (RO): PostalCode verification and missing address fixes.
- Saudi Arabia (SA): New parsing of SecondaryNumber in address format.
- Spain (ES): Removed extra Thoroughfare field.
- Ukraine (UA): Corrected Locality spelling.
- United States (US): Fixes for Locality, SubAdministrativeArea, Building parsing, PostBox prefix, and PostalcodeSecondary accuracy.

## Geographic data hierarchy

The following countries received targeted GDH (Geographic Data Hierarchy) updates:

- Canada (CA): Correction of AdministrativeArea for Calgary and removal of 727 incorrect postal codes from multiple localities.
- Mexico (MX): Added PostalCode '20374' under SubAdministrativeArea 'Aguascalientes'; restricted PostalCode '5097' to three localities: Redwood Park, Ridgehaven, and St. Agnes.
- Netherlands (NL): Resolved missing postal codes, including ranges beginning with 2500–2509 and 3508.
- United Kingdom (GB): Removed obsolete postal codes for Ashford, Oakham, and Richmond; corrected AdministrativeArea for 14 localities (Acharacle, Auchterarder, Chester, Crickhowell, Forest Row, Glasgow, Glossop, Henlow, Iver, Kinross, Llandovery, Uxbridge, Waltham Abbey, Wirral).

## API

Enhancements to the API engine include:

- Resolved bug where `SuppressAddressField` matching failed under some conditions.
- Reference matching for `Thoroughfare` now improved globally.
- New logic to prevent performance degradation from excessive parsing and large match candidate sets.
- Improved casing behavior: fields added by the enhance process now retain original casing.
- Parsing bug resolved: numbers are no longer assigned to both `SubBuilding` and `Premise` fields.
- Australia (AU): Improved shortlisting of match candidates in Australia for better scoring precision.
- Japan (JP): Premise matching logic in Japan now recognizes hyphens (e.g., "1-1-1" vs. "111") to prevent ambiguous matches.
- Italy (IT) and United States (US): Parsing fix - `Thoroughfare` was incorrectly mapped to `Locality` or `AdminArea` in some IT and US addresses.
- United States (US): `AVC` and `Postalcode` field verification improved for US addresses, including `PostalcodeSecondary` accuracy.
- United States (US): `PostBox` prefix parsing corrected in US addresses.

# Reltio Address Cleanser update - Sep 2025

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Platform changes at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/reltio-address-cleanser-update---sep-2025?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs

**Keywords:** cass server options in address cleanser, usps preferred city in reltio cass, preserve alias street names cass, how to use casspreservealias option, address verification settings in reltio, cassuseuspspreferredcity configuration, cass options for tenant physical config, configure cass options for address cleanser, usps city override, cass, cleanser, address


Learn about the updates to the Reltio Address Cleanser in September 2025

Here are the updates to the [Reltio Address Cleanser](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-reference/out-of-the-box-cleanse-functions/address-cleanser?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) in September 2025.

You now have additional server options when using CASS to verify the addresses.

## Request-level options

The following server options are now supported and can be configured in your tenant's physical configuration: 

- `CassUseUSPSPreferredCity` - Returns USPS-preferred city names instead of default municipality names. Here's an example:
  - *Input*: `1205 Sulphur Springs Rd, Manchester, MO 63021`
  - *Without*: Returns **Manchester**
  - *With*: Returns **Ballwin**
- 

  `CassPreserveAlias` - Retains original street names when aliases exist. Here's an example:
  - *Input*: `680 S MAIN ST, VENICE, UT 84701`
  - *With*: Returns **Main St**
  - *Without*: Returns **S Cove View Rd**

- ISO code correction in Kosovo (XK): Updated ISO-3 from XKV to XKX.

Global engine enhancements:

- Improved address matching algorithm for Level 4 and above .
- Enhanced numeric thoroughfare matching.
- Improved dominant script correction.
- Fixed ranged-field output formatting.

## Countries with major address dataset rebuilds

The following dataset rebuilds and major improvements were applied:

- **Türkiye (TR)**: Updated hierarchy handling so districts are populated in `Locality` instead of `SubAdministrativeArea`. `DependentLocality` is now populated only for certain addresses that contain towns known locally but not officially.
- **Brazil (BR)**: Added a Residential-Commercial (`ResCom`) flag to indicate property type. Supported values are `Res` for residential, `Com` for commercial, `R/C` for residential/commercial, and `Unk` for unknown.
- **Romania (RO)**: Corrected the output order for building-specific information in Latin script in the `SubBuilding` section. The corrected order is building, entrance, floor, and apartment.
- **Bulgaria (BG)**: Corrected the output order for building-specific information in Latin script in the `SubBuilding` section. The corrected order is building, entrance, floor, and apartment.

## Data improvements

The May and June 2026 releases include several data improvements that enhance address parsing, formatting, and verification accuracy across multiple countries. These improvements include:

- `Address verification` improvements: Sweden (SE) and Australia (AU)
- `Hierarchy` handling improvement: Türkiye (TR)
- `Premise`, `Building`, and `SubBuilding` parsing improvements: Australia (AU) and Great Britain (GB)
- `Locality` values and formatting: Australia (AU) and Greece (GR)
- `Thoroughfare` output and parsing improvements: Brazil (BR), Greece (GR), and Canada (CA)
- `Packstation` address output improvement: Germany (DE)

## Geographic data hierarchy updates

The following GDH (Geographic Data Hierarchy) updates were applied:

- **Canada (CA)**: Resolved missing postal codes.
- **France (FR)**: Cleaned up an obsolete postal code.
- **Germany (DE)**: Fixed `PostalCode` mapping.
- **Korea, Republic of (KR)**: Fixed missing `Locality` values under the provinces `Gyeonggi-do` and `Daegu`.
- **Spain (ES)**: Added `Vizcaya` as a valid alias of the `Bizkaia` administrative area.

These updates improve address parsing, returned address structure, geographic hierarchy consistency, and verification accuracy during address cleansing.

# Multi-Factor Authentication Now Available

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Platform changes at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/multi-factor-authentication-now-available?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


We are excited to announce that Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP) Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is now available for all customers.

As of September 2024, we are excited to announce that Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP) [Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/multi-factor-authentication-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) is now available for all customers. Administrators can choose between authenticator-based MFA and email-based MFA. After two months of optional enrollment, Reltio will enforce email-based MFA across all non-SSO users from all customers and partners. This initiative enhances security and protects user accounts from unauthorized access. Check out our [previous announcement](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/enhance-your-security-with-single-sign-on-sso-and-prepare-for-multi-factor-authentication-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) for context and more information.

## Preferred Choice: Single Sign-On (SSO)

We strongly encourage integrating with your Identity Providers (IDPs) via SAML or OpenID Connect (OIDC) for simplified and secure authentication. This is the recommended authentication method for all customers, and we highlighted the importance of adopting it in a previous email and our [blog](https://www.reltio.com/blogs/enhance-your-security-with-single-sign-on-sso-and-multi-factor-authentication-mfa/). Please check the following documentation links to adopt SSO for your users and tenants:

- [Guide for SSO migration](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/enhance-your-security-with-single-sign-on-sso-and-prepare-for-multi-factor-authentication-mfa/migrating-from-single-factor-to-sso-authentication-in-reltio?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
- [Enabling SSO for existing customers](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/authenticate-with-sso/sso-configuration?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
- [Guide to SAML Integration](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/authenticate-with-sso/security-assertion-markup-language-saml-single-sign-on-sso?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
  - [Demo Configuring SAML](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/security-applications/sso-configuration-at-a-glance/sso-configuration-based-on-saml?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
- [Guide to OIDC Integration](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/authenticate-with-sso/oauth-2.0openid-connect-oidc-single-sign-on-sso?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
  - [Demo Configuring OIDC](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/security-applications/sso-configuration-at-a-glance/sso-configuration-based-on-oidc?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)

## For Non-SSO Users

Reltio will enforce MFA on all non-SSO users, including admin, contractor, and testing accounts. If, by November 4th, 2024, you don't implement SSO or if you implement it partially, Reltio will enforce Multi-Factor Authentication for all users not under SSO.

## Key Dates and Actions

- **September 16th, 2024**: Enable MFA and enroll users in email-based MFA or via your preferred authenticator apps.
- **November 4th, 2024**: Enforce MFA for all users. Users who have not yet configured MFA will be automatically enrolled in email-based MFA.

  > **Important:** To avoid disrupting automated processes, **service accounts** must be migrated to client credentials before Nov 4. Reltio will assist in identifying service accounts and provide guidance on migration.

If you have any questions, please contact us, see note [Get help in Support Portal](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

Thank you for your cooperation in enhancing our platform's security.

# Enhance your security with Single Sign-On (SSO) and prepare for Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Platform changes at a glance


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/enhance-your-security-with-single-sign-on-sso-and-prepare-for-multi-factor-authentication-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about improving your security with SSO, Client credentials , and MFA sign ons.

As part of our ongoing commitment to providing our customers with the highest level of security, we are excited to share important updates about the steps we are taking to further safeguard your Reltio accounts. We strongly encourage all customers to implement Single Sign-On (SSO), prepare for the upcoming Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) capabilities, and migrate service users to client credentials.

## Why Single Sign-On (SSO)?

Implementing SSO with your enterprise identity provider (IDP) is an industry-standard best practice for enhancing the security and efficiency of your user management. By integrating with your IDPs via Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) or OpenID Connect (OIDC), SSO offers numerous benefits:

- **Streamlined access:** Users can access multiple applications without needing to log in separately to each one.
- **Reduced password fatigue:** With fewer passwords to remember, users are less likely to resort to insecure password practices.
- **Improved user productivity:** Users spend less time logging in and more time on productive tasks.
- **Centralized security controls:** IT administrators can manage access policies and monitor authentication activities from a single platform.

## How to Implement SSO

We support SSO integration via SAML and OIDC. To help you get started, we have prepared comprehensive guides for each method:

- [Enabling SSO for existing customers](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/authenticate-with-sso/sso-configuration?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
- [Guide to SAML Integration](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/authenticate-with-sso/security-assertion-markup-language-saml-single-sign-on-sso?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
  - [Demo Configuring SAML](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/security-applications/sso-configuration-at-a-glance/sso-configuration-based-on-saml?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
- [Guide to OIDC Integration](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/authenticate-with-sso/oauth-2.0openid-connect-oidc-single-sign-on-sso?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
  - [Demo Configuring OIDC](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/security-applications/sso-configuration-at-a-glance/sso-configuration-based-on-oidc?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)

These guides provide step-by-step instructions on seamlessly integrating your IDPs with Reltio.

## Preparing for Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

Reltio will require MFA for non-SSO users (users who cannot use SSO) starting November 4, 2024. If you're not leveraging SSO, you may use Reltio MFA via an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) or via email.

**Key dates:**

- **September 16, 2024:** MFA became available for all users.
- **November 4, 2024:** MFA enforcement rollout began. You'll be notified of your date in advance, with time and support needed for a smooth transition.

## Managing Service Accounts

All customers must adopt client credentials and stop using username/password for API access. Reltio will disallow API access using username/password by February 4, 2025. Client credentials are required for any integration or API usage with Reltio. Client credentials authentication is the secure, standards-compliant method to access Reltio’s platform, which provides granular control and audit trails for services. For more information, see topic [Guide to Creating Client Credentials](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/security-applications/client-credentials-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## Next Steps

To ensure a smooth transition and enhance the security of your accounts, we recommend the following steps:

- **Implement SSO:** Use the provided guides to integrate SSO for your users and tenants.
- **Prepare for MFA:** Be ready for MFA if SSO is partially or not implemented. In other words, if you don’t enable SSO to all your users, your non-SSO users will have to enroll in MFA.
- **Migrate Service Accounts:** Transition service accounts to client credentials to maintain uninterrupted automated processes.

## Support and Resources

We understand that changes to your login process may require adjustment. We are working on additional documentation and resources for you.

If you have any questions, please read our [FAQ](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/enhance-your-security-with-single-sign-on-sso-and-prepare-for-multi-factor-authentication-mfa/enhance-security-with-sso-and-prepare-for-mfa---faq?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs). Otherwise contact your preferred partner or us, see topic [Get help in Support Portal](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).
