# 2023.3.5.0 weekly release notes | 13-Dec-2023
**Keywords:** 2023.3 release, 2023.3 weekly releases


Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the 2023.3.5.0 weekly releases.

Find out what's new and notable each week in the Reltio Connected Data Platform 2023.3.

> **Important:** The 2023.3.5.0 release scheduled for 11-Dec-2023 will be available on 13-Dec-2023.

Get in the groove with Reltio's cool new capabilities and rock to the remix of classic features:

**Loser relationship DCR automatic removal**

Previously, when you merged relationships, we didn't remove the data change request (DCR) associated with the loser relationship. We changed our DCR behavior to automatically remove the DCR associated with the loser relation after a merge. For more information, see topics [Delete Data Change Request](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/data-change-request-api/delete-data-change-request?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Merge matched data](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/resolve-potential-matches/potential-matching-at-a-glance/potential-matching-reference/merge-matched-data?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**DQ Dashboard Consolidation Rate chart change**

The DQ Dashboard Consolidation rate chart previously displayed an inflated ratio for Reltio OV records compared to other source system crosswalks. We changed the calculation that included Reltio crosswalks both separately as well as within other source crosswalks, so the metric now provides a more accurate ratio. For more details, see topic [Consolidation rate chart](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/monitor-data-quality/data-quality-monitoring-at-a-glance/data-quality-monitoring-reference/real-time-data-quality-dashboard-charts/consolidation-rate-chart?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Final curtain for legacy features**

We hope you've made a close connection with these new and improved data synchronization features debuted last November:

- [Reltio Snowflake Connector](https://docs.reltio.com/en/integrate/export-data-from-reltio-in-bulk/export-data-from-reltio-to-business-intelligence-tools/reltio-snowflake-connector?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)
- 

  [Reltio Google BigQuery (GBQ) Connector](https://docs.reltio.com/en/integrate/export-data-from-reltio-in-bulk/export-data-from-reltio-to-business-intelligence-tools/reltio-google-bigquery-gbq-connector?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)





From 11-Dec-2023, we'll no longer maintain or support the retired cast members they replaced:

- Reltio Analytics
- Reltio Reporting
- Data Science (RDS)
- Legacy Reltio Connected Data for Snowflake





For more information, see the previously published playbill [Reltio Analytics, Reporting, Data Science, and Connected Data for Snowflake deprecation notice](https://docs.reltio.com/en/discover/release-notes/say-farewell-to-departing-features/reltio-analytics-reporting-data-science-and-connected-data-for-snowflake-deprecation-notice---nov-2023?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**One click to open links in Hub**

In the **Profile** view, it takes one click less to open a link. You don't have to right-click and choose the **Open in a new tab** option anymore. Now, just press the `Ctrl` key and click the link to automatically open it in a new tab.

# 2023.3.6.0 weekly release notes | 18-Dec-2023
**Keywords:** 2023.2 release, 2023.2 weekly releases


Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the 2023.3.6.0 weekly releases.

Find out what's new and notable each week in the Reltio Connected Data Platform 2023.3.

Get in the groove with Reltio's cool new capabilities and rock to the remix of classic features:

**Data Modeler - RDM lookup to Relationship attributes**

The Data Modeler didn't previously map RDM lookups to Relationship attributes, which required you to manually update these attributes directly in your tenant configuration. We replaced this difficult and error-prone process with a new **lookup** pop-up for Relationship attributes, so you can add, update, or delete the RDM lookup configuration. For more information, see topic [Creating New Relationship Types](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/model-data/data-modeling-at-a-glance/data-modeling-operation/define-relationships/creating-new-relationship-types?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Grouping type match rule verification**

The Data Modeler didn't verify if attributes had values on the fields listed in the match rule, when you created or edited household groups on the Console Data Modeler. With this release, the Data Modeler blocks the creation of a household group for entities that have attributes without values on those fields. For more information, see topic [Grouping: Basic mode](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/model-data/data-modeling-at-a-glance/data-modeling-operation/configure-grouping-types/grouping-basic-mode?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**RDM transcode errors for Reference attributes**

In the **Profile** view, you can now view RDM transcode errors for reference attributes in the **View** mode. Click the error to navigate to the relevant attribute. For more information, see topic [Profile Attribute Facets](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/manage-profiles/profile-management-at-a-glance/profile-navigation/profile-attributes/profile-attribute-facets?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## Create model patients in Reltio for Life Sciences

Accurate patient data drives better patient outcomes. Unifying patient data from various sources provides a more complete and holistic view of patients' health histories, treatments, and outcomes. This comprehensive understanding allows for more informed decision-making in research and drug development. Reltio provides a 360-degree view of each patient in our unified and centralized repository by consolidating patient data from various sources, such as Electronic health records (EHRs), claims data, and clinical trial data.

Reltio for Life Sciences provides data models and configurations for patients and consumers: 

**Relationship types**

- 

  Person Has Address
- 

  Research Subject (Person to Study)
- 

  Person to Prescriber (Person to HCP)
- 

  Person to Provider Organization
- 

  Person to Person (Caregiver, Guarantor, Contact, and so on)

**Interaction types**

Episode of care:

- 

  Home & Community Care
- 

  Acute Care
- 

  Rehabilitation
- 

  Aged Care

- 

  Person Type
- 

  Address Type
- 

  Email Type
-

- 

  Status
- 

  Policy Consent Type
- 

  Multi Channel Type

  Consent Policy Decision
- 

  Consent Provision Purpose
- 

  ICD10_CM (Diagnosis Code)
- 

  Education
- 

  Ethnicity
- 

  Race
- 

  Language

## Pump up your data quality volume with DVFs

We've enhanced Data Validation Functions (DVFs) to detect and prevent poor-quality entity and relationship data from being loaded into Reltio and to provide a more tailored and precise data quality validation process. Look at you, all empowered to make informed business decisions based on clean, reliable data:

**RDM attributes**

Don't toss red RDM attributes into a load of Reltio whites! Create a DVF with our new RDM lookup condition to detect and warn you about any invalid RDM values before you put them in the wash.

**System attributes**

Need to ensure an end date is greater than a start date for a particular entity or apply a DVF to specific entity roles like Pharmacy but not Hospital? Create a DVF to tag potential errors for system attributes like start and end date, tags, and roles.

**Source system name**

Keeping your eye on data from a particular source? Create a DVF that runs only when an entity has a crosswalk from that source system. For example, the Duns number shouldn't be missing when an entity has a DnB crosswalk.

**Relationship attributes**

No need for a counselor to evaluate the state of your relationship. Create a DVF to validate relationships you're bringing into Reltio.

**Revalidate job**

Revalidate relationships after creating or updating a relationship DVF to validate existing data from the Console Tenant Management application.

## Wise up with Match IQs pretrained ML model

Get ready to replace manual labor with pretrained machine learning (ML). Sure, as a data steward and match expert tag team, you're smart enough to build a matching model for matching by yourself. But do you really want to endure the tedious process of repetitively configuring, verifying, and tuning matches to train the ML model yourself? Treat yourself to our new pretrained ML match/merge model to augment your data team productivity with automated, accurate match-and-merge for the Life Sciences HCP data model:

**Fast, simple, accurate matching**

Pretrained ML models automatically analyze large datasets to find patterns and other insights in the data, making them faster and more effective over time.

**Improve entity resolution accuracy**

ML models pretrained using industry-standard data sources can lead to more accurate entity resolution with little to no effort from data stewards

The new Slice filter in the the metadata security configuration restricts entity access to specific sources based on a role. Restrict users from roaming your source corridors by creating roles with access to limited sources. Assign such roles only to users, who will see data only from the sources assigned to the role.

## Part ways with outdated matches using automatic unmerge

It happens. Entities grow apart. No need for you to brood when merged records no longer meet match criteria after updates, dear Data Steward. Let the automatic unmerge feature take the sting out of parting. It monitors and detects simple or nested attributes that no longer meet your match criteria and automatically unmerges their underlying crosswalks:

**Boost data steward productivity**

Eliminate the need for extensive ongoing manual unmerge tasks and custom IT projects.

**Increase match rule revision flexibility**

Seamlessly onboard data sources without requiring massive manual rework.

**Improve data quality and matching accuracy**

Reduce false positive matches in core data.

**Scale unmerge efficiency**

Even as data volumes grow, unmerge records in real-time or in batch mode.

## Protect your data quality from outliers

Look over there. Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No, it's ML-powered anomaly detection — the caped crusader in the Reltio Data Quality universe charged with keeping your dataset safe from data villains. Our superhero focuses his laser vision on external sources to chase down poor quality data that could corrupt existing data and impact both insights and decision making. With his ML-driven analysis, he automatically identifies outliers (unusual patterns) and reveals the would-be infiltrators via the DQ Dashboard for Data Stewards to review and address at the source:

**ML-powered automation**

Continuously inspects and detects data anomalies

**Greater data steward productivity**

Intuitive charts identify and flag anomalies over time

**Real-time rich data and actionable insights**

Drill-down charts enable quick remediation.

## Serve yourself a custom workflow

Remember when you had to create a BPMN file for a new custom workflow and save it to your local computer — and do it again every time you updated it? Or, when you had to compile your own JAVA code, send the code files to Reltio Customer Engineering to review with you over several iterations before they could approve it and register a JAR file in your tenant? Those days will soon be over.

Drum roll, please! Introducing self-service features in the Workflow Modeler to manage custom workflows:

**Reltio code development pipelines**

Subscribe to the Reltio code development pipelines in Bitbucket and push your custom code there, where we'll automatically review the code and suggest changes/fixes. Hey, presto! Changes made, code approved, JAR file automatically compiled and uploaded, and you're automatically notified in the Workflow Modeler when ready for registration.

**Workflow Modeler**

A new **Business process** page displays published workflows and their associated BPMN files. View file properties, open them for editing, and save them right here. You don’t need to export them anymore.

**Validation errors**

The `keyAttributeURIs` attribute was a subset of the `matchFieldURIs` attribute, which prevented you from using these parameters separately. We made these parameters independent, so now you can have different attributes in `matchField` and `keyAttribute` configuration. For more details, see topics [Nested Attributes](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/data-change-request-api/nested-attributes?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [keyAttributesURI options](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/entity-management-apis/entity-management-apis-at-a-glance/entities-api/update-entities/partial-overrides/keyattributesuri-options?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.1.10.0 weekly release notes | 29-Apr-2024
**Keywords:** 2024.1 release, 2024.1 weekly releases


Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the 2023.4.1.10.0 weekly release.

Find out what's new and notable each week in the Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.1.

**Load data icon for complex saved and recent searches**

In the Hub **Saved & Recent Searches** page and the **Saved searches** chart in the **Profile stats** page, the **Number of profiles** column previously displayed the number of results associated with each search query. This required all saved or recent search queries to be executed before any of these results could be displayed. This could be resource-intensive for queries with large data volumes or complex filters, potentially impacting other processes also running in the tenant. We implemented additional checks to identify such complex search queries before retrieving results and displaying their counts details. To enable these checks you must add an entry to the `com.reltio.plugins.ui.json` file. The **Number of profiles** column then displays a **Load data** icon instead of the actual profile counts for such complex searches. Click this icon to execute the search query and obtain its profile count. For more information, see topics [Working with Saved and Recent Searches](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/search/search-at-a-glance/search-operation/working-with-saved-and-recent-searches?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Configuring Dashboards](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/explore-data-insights/data-insights-at-a-glance/data-insights-reference/configuring-dashboards?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Potential matches and relevance-based match scores in Reltio Data Pipeline for GBQ**

The Reltio Data Pipeline for GBQ previously synchronized only entity data in the matches dataset. The pipeline now also synchronizes potential matches and relevance-based match scores, offering complete insight into relevance-based match rules. For more information, see topic [Matches dataset for the JSON data schema](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/data-integrations/data-pipelines-at-a-glance/reltio-data-pipeline-for-gbq-at-a-glance/reltio-data-pipeline-for-gbq-set-up/datasets-for-the-gbq-data-schema/datasets-for-the-gbq-json-based-data-scheme/matches-dataset-for-the-json-data-schema?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.1.13.0 weekly release notes | 20-May-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.1.13.0 weekly release.

Find out what's new and notable each week in the Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.1.

Get in the groove with Reltio's cool new capabilities and rock to the remix of classic features:

**Coming soon to a tenant near you—2024.2!**

The countdown to our second major release of the year is underway. Register to join our Product Managers in the [2024.2 Product Release Customer and Partner Webinar](https://community.reltio.com/events/event-description?CalendarEventKey=e512c3c7-1e39-4e89-8b6d-018f6439211a&CommunityKey=d172c579-9c0e-4e9f-a9bf-fdfeb2fb98ac&Home=%2fevents%2fcalendar) on 22-May-2204. Then check out our Release Notes next week to learn more about the key new features available to you to preview in your own tenant.

**Reltio Enrichment with D&B APIs enhancements for failed jobs**

If a D&B Batch Job you created was interrupted during execution, the Reltio Enrichment with D&B logged an error message and marked the job as FAILED. We've improved the way it handles job execution failures:

- Retry mechanism for executed job: Reltio Enrichment with D&B now automatically attempts to restart an interrupted job.
- Email notification: the new `notificationEmails` parameter in `D&B Monitoring API` and `D&B Batch API` enables you to receive notifications if a job fails.
- Restart job method: the new method in `D&B Batch API` lets you restart a failed job and preserve its history.



For more information, see topics[Create D&B Batch Job](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/data-integration-apis/data-integration-apis-at-a-glance/db-connector-apis/create-db-batch-job?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs), [Monitoring Background Jobs](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/data-integration-apis/data-integration-apis-at-a-glance/db-connector-apis/monitoring-background-jobs?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Restart Job](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/data-integration-apis/data-integration-apis-at-a-glance/db-connector-apis/restart-job?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.1.15.0 weekly release notes | 03-Jun-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.1.15.0 weekly release.

Find out what's new and notable each week in the Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.1.

**Documentation Portal Search enhancements**

We’ve been working behind the scenes to enhance your experience with our unified Search. With a recent upgrade in our search engine, we can now tweak more options to delight you with more relevant results when you search for information.

Check out these three exciting enhancements:

*Image: i-search-enhancements-page-results.png*

**Feedback functionality**

We've widened our scope for collecting your feedback. Earlier, you could submit feedback on a Search results page only, but now you can also share your inputs on our content.

- To share your feedback on a search results page: Select the **Give search feedback** icon on the right side of your Search results page. In the displayed dialog box, enter your rating and/or comment and select **Submit feedback**.

  *Image: i-search-enhancements-srchfeedback.png*
- To share your feedback on topic content: Select the green thumbs up or red thumbs down icon in the **Was this content helpful?** box at the end of the topic. In the displayed dialog box, enter your feedback on the content and select **Submit feedback**. Share your email address if you want us to connect with you.

  *Image: i-search-enhancements-page-topic.png*

**Save for later option**

Save a specific topic from a Search results page for future reference with the **Save for later** option *Image: i-search-bookmarkicon.png*.

Select the **Saved Bookmarks and Results** icon in the toolbar at the top of the Search results page when you want to revisit these references.

**Preview option**

Select the **Preview** option *Image: i-search-previewicon.png* for a specific topic from a Search results page to open the topic in its own separate panel while staying on the Search results page.

Go ahead and give these new features a try! We keep a constant eye on the performance of our Search engine to ensure you find what you need the first time.

# 2024.1.16.0 weekly release notes | 10-Jun-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.1.16.0 weekly release.

Find out what's new and notable each week in the Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.1.

**2024.2 here we come!**

Our Product, Engineering, and Documentation teams have been busy wrapping up new features for the upcoming major release. We have all the details in the [Preview release notes](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/release-notes-at-a-glance/2024.2-release-notes/2024.2-major-release-notes?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Generate events for Salesforce mapping changes**

Reltio Integration for Salesforce synchronizes entity data between Salesforce and the Reltio platform. Previously, each change to a mapped Salesforce object triggered a entity sync to Reltio, regardless of whether this change contained a field mapped in the Salesforce Profile. With the use of the new `checkFieldsChanged` parameter, only changes that contain mapped fields trigger a full entity synchronization to Reltio. For more information, see topic [Configure your Salesforce Connector Profile](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/data-integration-apis/data-integration-apis-at-a-glance/salesforce-connector-api/configure-your-salesforce-connector-profile?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Got Pinned or Ignored Data? Our new Filters for Get Entity and Relation APIs can help**

Have you ever needed to quickly identify which of your entities or relationships were marked as `Pinned` or `Ignored` ? We've got great news! In our latest update to the `Get Entity API` and `Relation API`, we introduced filtering to let you easily search for records with `Pinned` or `Ignored` attributes. This addresses the previous lack of direct search capabilities for these specific attribute states. For more information, see topics [Filtering Entities](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/entity-management-apis/entity-management-apis-at-a-glance/entities-api/get-entity/filtering-entities?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Relations Filtering](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/relation-management-apis/relation-management-apis-at-a-glance/relations-api/relations-filtering?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Data Change Request reviewers apply!**

Before, to approve or reject a data change request (DCR), users had to have privileges over the objects in the DCR. Now, you can set up users with a reduced set of privileges to handle DCRs. The users won't have direct control over the objects in the DCR, just permission to approve or reject DCRs. For more information, see topic [Permissions](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/data-change-request-api/permissions?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.1.2.0 weekly release notes | 04-Mar-2024
**Keywords:** 2023.3 release, 2023.3 weekly releases


Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the 2023.4.1.2 weekly release.

Find out what's new and notable each week in the Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.1. 

**D&B Batch Enrichment**

The `Match API` within the D&B Batch Enrichment returned an `invalid structure` error when it couldn't match entities that were missing target URIs. We now ensure that the API uses the D&B DUNS number to match records when the URI is missing, so that potential matches are correctly displayed in the Profile view. For more information, see topic [Create D&B Batch Job](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/data-integration-apis/data-integration-apis-at-a-glance/db-connector-apis/create-db-batch-job?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Cleanse**

The address cleanser previously didn't return the `ResultStrings` and `DPV Footnotes` fields. To help you identify reasons for unverified or partially verified addresses and correct/improve the data you send to cleanser, the address cleanser now returns these fields. For information, see topic [Address cleansing status fields](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-reference/out-of-the-box-cleanse-functions/address-cleanser/address-cleansing-properties/address-cleansing-status-fields?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Grouping**

In the **Console Data Modeler**, you could select subattributes in **Grouping Types**, which the system couldn't automatically match. Now when you create or edit **Grouping Types**, you can select only primary attributes. For more information, see topic [Create grouping type configurations](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/model-data/data-modeling-at-a-glance/data-modeling-operation/configure-grouping-types/create-grouping-type-configurations?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

To improve the security, availability, and efficiency of the Reltio Connected Data Platform, we're deprecating the Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) format for access tokens with an expiration of 60 minutes or less. # 2024.1.6.0 weekly release notes | 01-Apr-2024
**Keywords:** 2023.3 release, 2023.3 weekly releases


Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the 2023.4.1.6 weekly release.

Find out what's new and notable each week in the Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.1. 

**Unify, manage, and mobilize trusted, interoperable data in real time**

We're evolving our capabilities beyond master data management into data unification and management. Our new Reltio Connected Data Platform product lines for Reltio Entity Resolution, Reltio Multidomain Master Data Management (MDM), and Reltio 360 Data Products, enable you to focus on data outcomes, increase efficiency, manage risk, and drive growth. 

*Image: i-platform-3tiers-marketing.png*

**Reltio Entity Resolution**

Our Reltio Entity Resolution (Reltio ER) offering uniquely identifies and resolves entities. Simply upload your entity data and let Reltio ER's pretrained machine learning (ML) models detect duplicates, match and merge records, and assign a Universal ID to each merged record to give you a unified and accurate view of data. Export merged data to ensure consistent and reliable data across all platforms for improved decision-making and strategic planning. 

Reltio Entity Resolution for Individual lets you unify entity data like customers, vendors, and employees.

For more information, see topic [Reltio Entity Resolution data model](https://docs.reltio.com/en/products/reltio-entity-resolution/reltio-entity-resolution-at-a-glance/reltio-entity-resolution-reference/reltio-entity-resolution-data-model?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Reltio Multidomain Master Data Management**

Reltio Multidomain MDM includes all capabilities of Reltio Entity Resolution, as well as dynamic survivorship, reference data, built-in integration, data quality, and relationship views. Reltio Multidomain MDM is where you unify, cleanse, enrich, and share data. 

For more information, see topic [Reltio Multidomain Master Data Management (MDM) at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/products/reltio-multidomain-master-data-management-mdm/reltio-multidomain-master-data-management-mdm-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Reltio 360 Data Products**

Reltio 360 Data Products provides governed, standardized datasets for entity data that encompass entities, relationships, interactions, and transaction data that you can integrate with data from various sources, enrich with third-party data, and mobilize across systems.

Reltio 360 Customer Data Product provides a comprehensive view of your customer datasets.

**Case-sensitivity options for Nested attributes**

The nested attribute properties `matchFieldURIs` and `keyAttributeURIs` were previously case sensitive. Use the new `matchFieldURIsIgnoreCase` and `keyAttributeURIsIgnoreCase` options to ignore the case of data for these properties. For more information, see topics [Attributes configuration](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/configuration-api/attributes-configuration?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [keyAttributesURI options](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/entity-management-apis/entity-management-apis-at-a-glance/entities-api/update-entities/partial-overrides/keyattributesuri-options?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.1.8.0 weekly release notes | 15-Apr-2024
**Keywords:** 2024.1 release, 2024.1 weekly releases


Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the 2023.4.1.8 weekly release.

Find out what's new and notable each week in the Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.1. 

**Analytics - New data pipeline for Databricks Delta Lake**

Analyze and act on your data faster than ever by cleansing, deduplicating, and enriching it before it hits your cloud data warehouses. With this release, you can quickly and easily connect Reltio to your Databricks Delta Lake instance for high-quality data your business users can rely on.

This new data pipeline requires a subscription and configuration. For details, contact your Reltio Account Executive/Renewal Representative. For information on configuring the data pipeline, see topic [Reltio Data Pipeline for Databricks set up](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/data-integrations/data-pipelines-at-a-glance/reltio-data-pipeline-for-databricks-at-a-glance/reltio-data-pipeline-for-databricks-set-up?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).*Image: i-exportdata-databricks-reltio.png*

**Reltio Integration Hub (RIH)**

If you are an Integration Specialist or Integration Customer Admin, you can now access these features from RIH: 

- 

  Logs: Monitor and troubleshoot the recipes in a centralized manner in logs. Design recipes that can generate logs for different levels such as, Info, Warning, and Error using Logger by Workato Connector.
- 

  Event Streams: Implement integration solutions that require an event-driven and message-oriented architecture that separates publishers and consumers, so you can: 

  - 

    Chain the recipes sequentially with a messaging system that the connector implements.
  - 

    Build a recipe that publishes messages that multiple recipes can consume to start their workflow.

For more information, see topics [Setting up Reltio Integration Hub](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/integration-hub/integration-hub-at-a-glance/integration-hub-set-up?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# New features and enhancements

Check out new features and enhancements in the 2024.1 release.

Welcome to the 2024.1 release! We're excited to lead off in today's 29-Jan-24 Preview with our new AI (artificial intelligence)/ML (machine learning) offering to help your find the information you need faster than ever.

Read more about Reltio's Intelligent Assistant, new pre-trained ML model for Individual domain, new Product domain in the Life Sciences Velocity pack, as well as the full array of new features and functionality you'll be able to explore in the release GA on 19-Feb-24. We'll update these release notes then to provide links to topics with detailed information on the value of these new features and how to use them.

## Find out fast with RIA - Reltio's Intelligent Assistant

Well, hello there! I'm RIA - the little widget up here on the upper right side of your tenant UI. If you have a question about the Reltio Connected Data Platform, I'll find the answer pronto.

Go ahead and give it a go. Click the widget to open a panel, then type in a question. I'll return a brief answer as well as links to relevant topics with more detailed information. Click the link to visit the topic or the X to close the panel when you're done.

As an AI/ML widget, I can comb through Reltio's digital content and share Documentation topics faster than you can say bippity-boppity-boo. I'm always learning, so I'll let you know if I don't understand the question or I can't find a relevant answer.

*Image: RIA_gif_1.gif*

-

-

- 

  API
- 

  Storage

## Data Modeler enhancements for self-service configuration

Configure these data model features directly in the Console Data Modeler: 

**Reference attributes**

Create and edit Reference attributes for an entity in the Console Data Modeler just as you would Simple or Nested attributes.

**Nested entity attributes**

Configure all variations of **Match field** (`matchFieldURIs`) and **Key attribute** (`keyAttributeURIs`) to determine the conditions for merging and overriding sub nested attributes: 

- `matchFieldURIs`
- `matchFieldURIsExactOrNull`
- `matchFieldURIsExactOrAllNul`
- `keyAttributeURIs`
- `keyAttributeURIsExactOrNull`
- `keyAttributeURIsExactOrAllNull`

## Our most flexible Match IQ pretained ML models yet

Breathe a sigh of relief thanks to our pretrained machine learning (ML) models! Regardless of the industry you're in, use these ML models to bypass the tedious process of repetitively configuring, verifying, and tuning matches to train the ML models yourself.

**Fast, simple, accurate matching**

These Pretrained ML models, based on Large Language Models (LLMs) automatically analyze large datasets to find patterns and other insights in the data, making them faster and more effective over time:

- New Individual entity type for Consumer Data (B2C) velocity pack v3 (EA)
- Updated Healthcare Provider (HCP) entity type for Life Sciences velocity pack v3



.

**Unprecedented flexibility**

The new ML pretrained model for Individual entities is available out-of-the box for all market segments.

## Match service

Look at what you can do to make better matches:

**Improve matching accuracy and data quality with automatic unmerge**

- 

  Improve entity resolution accuracy using additional methods of comparison (Jaro-Winkler, Volume comparators, and enhanced Levenshtein comparators) that provide additional matching options for various use cases.
- 

  Unmerge with confidence! With the new reporting mode, get a count of consolidated profiles that no longer meet the matching criteria.
- Enhance flexibility in the unmerge process by specifying match rules and identifying the source systems to be considered during unmerging.

**Match criteria for single-member households**

Single-member households can now meet their match. With our automated householding feature, you could create single-member households for specific purposes like targeted product offerings. You weren't required to enter all of the attributes you'd need to group this single-member household with other households based on criteria in match rules. 

Now, when you create a single-member household, we verify whether the lone household member has the necessary attributes specified in the matching criteria. If not, we don't create a standalone household, thus optimizing the accuracy and efficiency of household generation while avoiding the unnecessary proliferation of single-member households that do not contribute to the intended grouping logic.

**Automatic unmerge considers relevance-based match rules**

The automatic unmerge capability we introduced in the 2023.3 release, unmerged consolidated records when the underlying individual records no longer met the criteria in the automatic match rules. We've enhanced this to also consider the criteria in relevance-based match rules.

# Additional features and enhancements

Learn about additional features and enhancements in the first release of 2024.

But wait, there's more!

**AWS Lambda functions Java upgrade**

We recommend upgrading your LCA functions from Java 8 to Java 17 for improved security, performance, and compatibility with new platform features and industry standards. For details on how to upgrade, see topic [AWS Lambda function Java upgrade](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/about-developer-resources/developer-resources-at-a-glance/customize-data-tasks-with-lcas/lca-deployment-using-aws-lambda/lca-deployment-as-aws-lambda/aws-lambda-function-java-upgrade?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Cleanse**

- 

  When multiple cleansers were used in a chain, the first cleanser didn't resolve the lookup values before passing it to the subsequent cleanser. We now ensure each cleanser resolves it's lookups before passing it to the next cleanser in the chain.
- 

  We are deprecating US Census 2010 dataset fields from the Reltio Address Cleanser, replacing those fields with US Census Plus dataset fields. You must upgrade your tenant business configuration and any other integrated components that use deprecated fields from the Census dataset. For more information, see topic [US Census replaced with Census Plus - Sep 2024](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/us-census-replaced-with-census-plus---sep-2024?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Global filters**

You can now add and delete search filters directly from the Global filter dialog. When deleting a saved search, you now have the option to retain the saved search as a global filter. For more information, see topic [Understanding the Global Filters](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/search/search-at-a-glance/search-operation/understanding-the-global-filters?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)

**Reltio to Salesforce synchronization filter**

Previously, any data updates in Reltio that weren't from a service user triggered the synchronization to Salesforce. We added synchronization filtering to our Reltio Integration with Salesforce, so you can trigger the synchronization only for updates to mapped fields. Enable this filter to improve the integration's performance, ensuring more precise data management. For details on how to enable the filter, see topic [Synchronization process](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/data-integrations/application-integration-at-a-glance/reltio-integration-for-salesforce-at-a-glance/reltio-integration-for-salesforce-set-up/getting-started-with-reltio-integration-for-salesforce/synchronization-process?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Data integration**

We simplify data integration for MDM with our low-code/no-code development environment, 1,000+ prebuilt connectors, and real-time performance with latency under 300 milliseconds. We're simplifying the terminology for the various types of connectivity and data exchange capabilities we provide:

- 

  Reltio Integration Hub

  Low-code/no-code productivity platform with prebuilt connectors and batch capabilities for accelerate data integration across multi-source environments.
- 

  Reltio Application Integrations

  Prepackaged, end-to-end integration (with data orchestration logic) for for third-party applications. Check out Reltio Integration for Salesforce.
- 

  Reltio Data Enrichment Integrations

  Prepackaged, end-to-end integration (with data orchestration logic) for third-party data sources. Check out Reltio Enrichment with 340B, BvD, D&B, DEA, and MedProd, and NPI.
- 

  Reltio Data Pipelines

  Unidirectional data flow from Reltio into a cloud data warehouse. Check out Reltio Data Pipelines for GBQ and for Snowflake.
- 

  Reltio IPaaS Connectors

  Technical connectors with no orchestration logic. Check out Reltio Connector for MuleSoft and for SnapLogic.





We reorganized the [Integrate landing page](https://docs.reltio.com/en/integrate?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) to help you navigate to the renamed connectors. We're working our way through renaming them across the DocPortal.

# 2024.2.1.0 weekly release notes | 24-Jun-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the 2024.2.1.0 weekly release.

Find out what's new and notable each week in the Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.2.

Get in the groove with Reltio's cool new capabilities and rock to the remix of classic features:

**Address cleanser update for Connecticut**

Starting in June 2024, the United States Postal Service (USPS) is updating counties per changes by the Connecticut legislature. In June 2022, the State of Connecticut adopted nine planning regions as county-equivalent geographic units, replacing the eight counties which had ceased to function as governmental and administrative entities in 1960.

The Reltio address cleanser now includes the USPS records for these planning regions in the **Sub-Administrative Area** field:

- CAPITOL
- GREATER BRIDGEPORT
- LOWER CT RIVER VLY
- NAUGATUCK VLY
- NORTHEASTERN CT
- NW HILLS
- SOUTH CENTRAL CT
- SOUTHEASTERN CT
- WESTERN CT

For example, the city of Hartford, formerly in Hartford county, is now in the new Capitol planning region.

*Image: i-addresscleanser-ct-counties.png*

For more information, see topic [Mapping Input Attribute](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-reference/out-of-the-box-cleanse-functions/address-cleanser/mapping-input-and-output-attributes/mapping-input-attribute?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Directional arrows in Relationship UI**

In the Hub Profile Relationship view, arrows depict relationships between the start and the end entity. We've corrected an error where the arrow directions and labels were inconsistent. Now the labels match the direction. For more information, see topic [Detailed View of the Related entity](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/hub/profiles-at-a-glance/profile-perspectives-tabs/profile-perspectives-navigation/relationships-perspective/detailed-view-of-the-related-entity?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.2.10.0 weekly release notes | 26-Aug-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.2.10.0 weekly release.

Check out what's new and notable in this Reltio Connected Data 2024.2.10.0 weekly release:

**Data Loading support for RELTIO_JSON files through API**

Previously, when you loaded data using a JSON file, the data loading job's transformation process converted the data into a table.

Now the Data Loader supports loading jobs for RELTIO_JSON files which don't need to go through the transformation process. This enables you to load a large number of records with a single data loader job.

We're rolling out this capability through our API first. In a future update this functionality will be made available in the Console UI.

**Consolidating records in the Console Data Loader**

Previously, you could only control whether the Data Loader consolidated records with the same crosswalk using the `Data Loader API`. Now, you can enable/disable this behavior with the **Consolidate records with same crosswalk value** option in the Console Data Loader.​ For more information, see topic [Create one entity from multiple records](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/load-and-export-data/data-loading-at-a-glance/data-loading-operation/load-data-with-data-loader/load-entities-into-a-tenant/create-one-entity-from-multiple-records?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Reltio Cleanser address data update**

We've updated the Reltio Cleanser to improve the quality of your address data:

- Refreshed the data of several countries, including Afghanistan, Australia, Canada, Spain, and the US, with updated address information.
- Corrected geocode data in Mexico, handled missing administrative areas in Spain, and resolved parsing issues for sub-building fields in Denmark.
- Standardized postal code lengths to 7 digits for Israel.
- Renamed the administrative area Csongrád to Csongrád-Csanád in Hungary.

# 2024.2.11.0 weekly release notes | 02-Sep-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.2.11.0 weekly release.

Check out what's new and notable in this weekly release:

**Search Before Create for Salesforce RIH**

In a previous release, we introduced the Reltio Integration for Salesforce (RIH) connector that uses RIH recipes to synchronize data between Reltio and Salesforce. We're now adding the Search Before Create (SBC) capability to this feature. SBC uses RIH recipes to search for records in Salesforce and Reltio, and imports the missing records into Salesforce. For more details, see topic [Search before create (SBC)](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/data-integrations/application-integration-at-a-glance/reltio-integration-for-salesforce-with-rih-at-a-glance/reltio-integration-for-salesforce-with-rih-overview/search-before-create-sbc?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Visible Attributes in Profile view**

When editing, suggesting, or viewing a profile, do you want attributes without values to show up in the Profile view? Configure your UI to include the `alwaysVisible` option for the attributes you want visible in all modes. This option applies to the Collaborative Profile Creation as well. For more information, see topic [Profiles at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/hub/profiles-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Single Sign-On (SSO)/Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) implementation dates extended**

We've changed the dates for implementing Single Sign-On (SSO)/Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) feature. For more information, see topic [Enhance your security with Single Sign-On (SSO) and prepare for Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/enhance-your-security-with-single-sign-on-sso-and-prepare-for-multi-factor-authentication-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Include additional input parameters while starting a workflow**

Previously, when you started a workflow, the Start Process Instance endpoint of the `Workflow API` only accepted limited input parameters. This required you to pass essential data through comments, leading to a less efficient process. Now, the endpoint accepts additional optional input parameters, such as task variables that you can use in your workflows allowing you for more flexibility and cleaner setups. For more information, see topic [Start a Process Instance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/workflow-apis/workflow-apis-at-a-glance/workflow-api/start-a-process-instance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)

# 2024.2.13.0 weekly release notes | 16-Sep-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.2.13.0 weekly release.

**Enhanced Security with Multi-Factor Authentication**

Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) adds an additional layer of security by requiring you to provide a second form of verification in addition to your password. This makes it much harder for attackers to gain access to accounts. Even if a your password is compromised, the second verification factor prevents unauthorized access. Reltio offers the following two options for MFA:

- **App-based MFA:** You can generate a Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) using an authentication app like Google Authenticator, Okta Verify, or Microsoft Authenticator. For more details, see [Enroll for app-based MFA](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/multi-factor-authentication-mfa/get-started-with-mfa/enroll-for-app-based-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).
- **Email-based MFA:** You will receive a verification code via email each time you log in. This will be the default method unless you opt for app-based MFA. For more details, see topic [Enroll for email-based MFA](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/multi-factor-authentication-mfa/get-started-with-mfa/enroll-for-email-based-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

For additional details, see our full announcement [Multi-Factor Authentication Now Available](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/multi-factor-authentication-now-available?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

> **Note:** Reltio will enforce MFA enablement automatically on 04-Nov-2024. For more details, see topic [Enable MFA](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/multi-factor-authentication-mfa/get-started-with-mfa/enable-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Databricks on GCP and support for Unity Catalog**

The Reltio Data Pipeline for Databricks now supports Google Cloud Platform (GCP), in addition to AWS and Azure. Furthermore, alongside Hive Metastore, the Databricks pipeline now supports Unity Catalog as a destination for your Delta tables across GCP, AWS, and Azure. Unity Catalog enhances data organization and governance, helping you achieve better data insights. For more information, see topic [Configure Databricks pipeline for GCP using Console UI](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/data-integrations/data-pipelines-at-a-glance/reltio-data-pipeline-for-databricks-at-a-glance/reltio-data-pipeline-for-databricks-set-up/configure-the-reltio-data-pipeline-for-databricks-for-gcp/configure-databricks-pipeline-for-gcp-using-console-ui?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.2.15.0 weekly release notes | 30-Sep-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.2.15.0 weekly release.

**Get ready for 2024.3!**

Our Product, Engineering, and Documentation teams have been busy wrapping up new features for the upcoming major release. We have all the details in our [2024.3 major release notes](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/release-notes-at-a-glance/2024.3-release-notes/2024.3-major-release-notes?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Reltio Cleanser address data update Sep 2024**

We've updated the Reltio Address Cleanser to improve the quality of your address data:

- 

  Expanded support for new postal code formats and improved address validation in Israel, Taiwan, and Türkiye.
- 

  Rebuilt country data for the United States, where a new data source has improved validation accuracy.
- 

  Refreshed country data for over 30 countries, incorporating the latest available address information.
- 

  Improved parsing for Canada (notably in Québec), France, Germany, Greece, Denmark, and Taiwan, ensuring more accurate address validation.





For a full list of changes, see topic [Reltio Address Cleanser update - Sep 2024](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/reltio-address-cleanser-update---sep-2024?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**More sample records from Batch Unmerge entities task**

We've increased the sample of records in the `batchUnmergeEntities` task response from 10 to 1000 to give you more clarity about the entities that are going to be unmerged. For more information, see topic [Automatic Unmerge Task](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/tasks-api/automatic-unmerge-task?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Reltio Cleanser out with US Census data fields**

As we announced earlier this year, we're deprecating the US Census data in favor of the US Census Plus data this month. Gone are the US Census data fields, replaced by the more granular US Census Plus data fields in the Reltio Address Cleanser. For more details, see topics [US Census replaced with Census Plus - Sep 2024](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/us-census-replaced-with-census-plus---sep-2024?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [US Census Plus data](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-reference/out-of-the-box-cleanse-functions/address-cleanser/enhanced-data/us-census-plus-data?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.2.3.0 weekly release notes | 08-Jul-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the 2024.2.3.0 weekly release.

Check out what's new and notable in this Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.2 weekly release:

**Improved entry file processing in Reltio Enrichment with D&B**

The Reltio Enrichment with D&B previously processed your entry files for updates to Reltio sequentially. With the new parameter IS_PARALLEL_FILE_PROCESSING set to true, the integration processes the entry files in parallel for improved performance. **Steamlined Collaborative Profile Creation**

Have you used the Collaborative Profile Creation feature, and its authoring workflow, to create profiles? Well, we've streamlined this process to make it even easier to accept or reject workflows. Now, instead of having to navigate to the Notification Inbox, reviewers and approvers can approve or reject them directly in the Profile view. For more information, see topic [Suggest and save profiles using the authoring workflow](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/manage-profiles/profile-management-at-a-glance/profile-management-operation/add-a-profile-using-collaborative-profile-creation-wizard/suggest-and-save-profiles-using-the-authoring-workflow?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.2.4.0 weekly release notes | 15-Jul-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the 2024.2.4.0 weekly release.

Check out what's new and notable in this Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.2 weekly release:

**Pinned and ignored attributes in Advanced search UI**

In our [2024.1.16.0 release](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/release-notes-at-a-glance/2024.1-release-notes/2024.1-weekly-release-notes?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs), we introduced new options to filter profiles by pinned and ignored attributes. These options are now also available in the Advanced Search UI. For more information, see topic [Exploring the Advanced Search](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/search/search-at-a-glance/search-navigation/exploring-the-advanced-search?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs). For the API details, see topics [Filtering Entities](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/entity-management-apis/entity-management-apis-at-a-glance/entities-api/get-entity/filtering-entities?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Relations Filtering](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/relation-management-apis/relation-management-apis-at-a-glance/relations-api/relations-filtering?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Relationship attributes in Profile Hierarchy facets**

Previously, the Hierarchy facet in the Hub Profile view showed only the relation type and the start and end date attributes for relationships. You can now configure specific relationship attributes to display in this facet, for example:

- 

  AffiliationSubType
- 

  HierarchyCode
- 

  AdditionalAttributes



For more information, see topic[Exploring the Hierarchy Management facet](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/model-data/data-modeling-at-a-glance/data-modeling-operation/define-hierarchies/exploring-the-hierarchy-management-facet?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Raw lookup values in address cleansing**

We've changed the way the Cleanser deals with unavailable RDM lookups for an attribute. Previously, if a lookup value wasn't provided, by default the cleanser used the default value for the attribute specified in that tenant. We've now introduced the `useRawValueAsDefaultForCleanse` parameter, so you can determine whether to use a raw value instead of the tenant default:

- 

  True: the cleanser uses the raw value in the source data.
- 

  False (default): the cleanser uses the tenant default value or null, if none is specified.

For more information, see topic [Configure cleanse to use raw value when lookup fails](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-set-up/configure-cleanse-functions/configure-cleanse-to-use-raw-value-when-lookup-fails?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.2.6.0 weekly release notes | 30-Jul-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the 2024.2.6.0 weekly release.

Check out what's new and notable in this Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.2 weekly release:

> **Important:** The 2024.2.6.0 release initially scheduled for 29-Jul-2024 was rescheduled for 30-Jul-2024.





**Enhanced Security with Multi-Factor Authentication**

To provide enhanced security for Reltio accounts, we're in the process of implementing Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). In the meantime, we're sharing our plans and recommended actions you can take to better prepare for the upcoming security changes. Specifically, for user accounts, we recommend that you adopt SSO and for system accounts we recommend client credentials; these simplify the login process and enhance security by centralizing authentication. For more information, see topic [Enhance your security with Single Sign-On (SSO) and prepare for Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/enhance-your-security-with-single-sign-on-sso-and-prepare-for-multi-factor-authentication-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Enhanced Match Rules with relevance score**

In the **Data Modeler** > **Match** tab, you define relevance score range for each match action for match rules. The relevance score range indicates the lowest and highest values that result in a match. If this rule defines multiple Match actions, the lowest Relevance score range defined in the first Match action must match the highest Relevance score range defined in the section Match action. For more information, see topic [Creating a New Match Rule](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/configuration-applications/data-modeler-at-a-glance/creating-a-new-match-rule?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Reltio Enrichment with D&B supports SafeTransPort (STP) in Monitoring capability**

We've added support for D&B SafeTransPort (STP) in our integration with D&B. You now have two Destination types available to transfer change notifications when you create a registration for D&B Monitoring: S3 and STP. For more details, see topic [Monitor Reltio Enrichment with D&B](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/data-integrations/data-enrichment-integrations-at-a-glance/reltio-enrichment-with-db-at-a-glance/reltio-enrichment-with-db-set-up/working-with-reltio-enrichment-with-db/monitor-reltio-enrichment-with-db?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.2.7.0 weekly release notes | 05-Aug-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the 2024.2.7.0 weekly release.

Check out what's new and notable in this Reltio Connected Data Platform 2024.2 weekly release:

**Clients restricted by tenant**

Say goodbye to customer-specific client access and hello to improved security with tenant-specific clients. Previously, each client could access all tenants under their corresponding customer. Now, you can specify the tenants that clients may access, ensuring access segregation among your environments. Existing clients remain unchanged; you have the option to explicitly remove individual tenants from them to restrict their access. For more information, see this Console UI topic [Add new client](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/security-applications/client-credentials-at-a-glance/manage-client-credentials/add-new-client?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and this API topic [Create a customer client](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/authentication-api/application-client-management-apis/create-a-customer-client?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Flexible Entity Resolution Network (FERN)-based matching - Early Access (EA)**

In the **Data Modeler** > **Match** tab, we introduced FERN-based matching for Individual entity types such as a contact or a broker agent. FERN provides pretrained models that automate real-time matching with the internal or external source as configured. You can define the matches based on the attributes including names, phone numbers, email address, and so on. For more information, see topics [FERN-based matching](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/configuration-applications/ai-powered-flexible-entity-resolution-network-fern-model-based-matching-at-a-glance/fern-based-matching?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Enable a pretrained FERN model](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/configuration-applications/ai-powered-flexible-entity-resolution-network-fern-model-based-matching-at-a-glance/fern-based-matching/use-a-pretrained-fern-model/enable-a-pretrained-fern-model?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Changes in Potential Matches UI**

Previously, in the **Profile** > **Potential Matches** tab, all Machine Learning (ML)-based potential matches were labeled as Match IQ. Now, these potential matches are labeled AI-powered models. 

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| *Image: ml_match_before.png* | *Image: ml_match_after.png* |



For more information, see topic[AI-powered Flexible Entity Resolution Network (FERN) model-based matching at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/configuration-applications/ai-powered-flexible-entity-resolution-network-fern-model-based-matching-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Control merging entities in Data Loader**

Previously, you couldn’t control whether the Data Loader merges records with the same crosswalk in data load jobs. Now, you have an option to enable/disable this behavior via the Reltio API. When disabled, the Data Loader skips the pre-processing step to check for duplicate crosswalks, resulting in faster load times.​ For more information, see topic [Create one entity from multiple records](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/load-and-export-data/data-loading-at-a-glance/data-loading-operation/load-data-with-data-loader/load-entities-into-a-tenant/create-one-entity-from-multiple-records?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Improved Data Loader threshold errors**

Previously, when you were performing a data loading job and the error threshold limit was reached, you would see the status "COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS". Now, the status is "STOPPED" with an additional error message like: "The job was stopped as error threshold limit 15% was reached. Actual is 16.8% (306 to 1819 profiles)." For more information, see topic [Data Loader at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/tenant-management-applications/data-loader-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Enhance your data security and compliance in RDM with role-based access control**

For Reference Data Management (RDM), we introduced an additional security mechanism that works alongside Reltio API permissions to restrict access to RDM tenant data. Using the new role-based access control for RDM, you can define roles and set precise permissions in the RDM tenant to increase data security. RDM's new feature allows you to create roles for specific job functions and manage access to different lookup types and values more effectively. For more information, see topic [Role-based access control (RBAC) for RDM](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/rdm/rdm-at-a-glance/rdm-set-up/role-based-access-control-rbac-for-rdm?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**DoubleMetaphoneMatchToken class with Exact operator fix**

We updated the `DoubleMetaphoneMatchToken` class to generate tokens using the correct double metaphone algorithm for attributes used in exact match expressions. This fix ensures that the tokenization process aligns with the expected behavior, improving the accuracy of matches. This change only impacts the behavior of `DoubleMetaphoneMatchToken` for attributes in exact match expressions. Attributes used in fuzzy match rules remain unaffected, as they already generate two tokens: a double metaphone token and a statistical fuzzy token. If you are using `DoubleMetaphoneMatchToken` for attributes in exact match rules, we recommend executing the Rebuild Match Table Task to update the tokenization scheme. For more details, see topic [Rebuild Match Table Task](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/tasks-api/rebuild-match-table-task?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# Data integration

Learn about the new Reltio connectors and integrations introduced in the 2024.2 release.

See what's new in our low-code/no-code development environment, prebuilt connectors, and extensive real-time and batch capabilities that enable you to accelerate integrating data across complex, multisource environments.

## Reltio Application Integrations

If you wanted a more powerful integration with Salesforce, we've got you covered:

**Reltio Integration for Salesforce (with RIH)**

Built on the strength of our low-code/no-code Reltio Integration Hub (RIH), our new Reltio Integration for Salesforce reduces development time, enhances flexibility, and improves troubleshooting processes with these features:

- Prebuilt recipes integrating Reltio B2B Velocity Pack with Salesforce Account and Contact Objects
- Extensive monitoring and troubleshooting through transparent RIH dashboards and configurable alerts in recipes
- Flexibility to modify business logic using low code-no code workflows
- Ability to create new integrations from the prebuilt recipes for expanded use cases including custom objects and Salesforce industry clouds

If you're looking to accelerate integration time lines to access real-time data synchronization between Salesforce and Reltio, we're on hand to help you migrate from our existing Reltio Integration for Salesforce.

No need to fix what's not broken? Carry on using our original integration from the Salesforce AppExchange.

| Get going with this feature | Get going with this feature |
| --- | --- |
| Availability | GA* |
| Product line | Reltio Multidomain MDM \| Reltio 360 Data Products |

## Reltio Data Catalog Integrations

Sync Reltio entity and relationship metadata to leverage Collibra's data catalog features for comprehensive data governance:

**Reltio Integration for Collibra**

Easily sync Reltio metadata with your Collibra data catalog for comprehensive data management. 

Seamlessly replicate Reltio entity and relationship metadata into your Collibra data catalog. This integration enhances data management capabilities by leveraging Collibra's data catalog tool: 

- 

  Seamless Metadata Sync: Automatically fetch and update entity and relationship metadata from Reltio to Collibra.
- 

  Enhanced Data Management: Use Collibra's advanced features such as business glossary and data lineage to add value to your Reltio data.
- 

  Selective Enablement: Enable the integration selectively for specific tenants as needed.



The integration fetches the latest entity and relationship metadata from the tenant's configuration and executes Collibra APIs to create, update, or delete assets in the Collibra data catalog, reflecting the latest changes in Reltio. Resync the data with a single click of button using RIH recipes for any changed entities or relationships.

## Reltio Business Critical Edition

We are excited to announce the launch of Reltio Business Critical Edition, designed to provide enhanced security, compliance, higher uptime, and performance for your mission-critical data management needs.

What's Included?

**Enhanced data recovery and higher uptime**

Achieve a Recovery Time Objective (RTO) of less than or equal to 1 hour and a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of less than or equal to 1 minute. The Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of less than 1 minute applies solely to data at rest. This does not cover data in transit, as external data transfer processes are beyond Reltio's control.

Availability SLA to 99.99%.

**Cross-region redundancy with mirrored tenant pairs**

Enhanced data protection and minimized downtime, ensuring that critical business functions continue seamlessly during and after disruptive events.

**Reltio Shield**

Advanced data protection and privacy features to meet stringent compliance requirements.

**Reltio Private Link**

Reltio Private Link offers secure, private connectivity solutions that allows your cloud to interact with the Reltio API without being exposed to the internet. This approach enhances security, privacy, and performance for your data interactions.

Future planned enhancements:

**Advanced analytics on dashboard**

Insights into disaster recovery readiness and performance.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to evolve Reltio Business Critical Edition to meet your business needs or contact your Reltio Account Executive/Renewal Representative.

## Flexible Entity Resolution Network (FERN)

Flexible Entity Resolution Network (FERN) pretrained machine learning models provide AI-powered matching of data attribute values in specified sources. These models are now walking the runway:

**LLM-based matching for Individual domain**

This model just stepped up from Early Access (EA) to General Availability (GA). Use this pretrained FERN model to match attributes in internal and external source data for the Individual type entity. Configure Individual entity matches based on attributes such as name, phone number, and email address.

**LLM-based matching for Organization domain**

This new model joins our line up at this release. Use this pretrained FERN model to match attributes in internal and external source data for the Organization type entity. Configure Organization entity matches based on attributes such as DoingBusinessAsName, Tax ID, and WebsiteURL.

**Faster matching with FERN**

We've combined our FERN and rule-based matching components to accelerate your matching speed. The engine now defines and stores the matching rules for various entity types in a centralized catalog service, rather than recreating them in each tenant . In the Console Data Modeler Entity types, lift the hood on the **Match** page to manage your AI-powered FERN model with up to three match rules.

## Strengthened Enterprise Security - Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

We remain firm in our commitment to provide you with the highest level of security in our platform with this enhancement to further safeguard access to your Reltio accounts.

*Image: i-security-mfasso.png*

We probably sound like a broken record, but this enhancement deserves to be played on heavy rotation. We made MFA available for all users 16-Sep-2024 to enroll in their preferred authenticator apps or via email. Next, we are enforcing MFA for non-SSO users from 04-Nov-2024.

**Enhanced Security with Multi-Factor Authentication**

Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) adds an additional layer of security by requiring you to provide a second form of verification in addition to your password. This makes it much harder for attackers to gain access to accounts. Even if a your password is compromised, the second verification factor prevents unauthorized access. Reltio offers the following two MFA options that you can set up from the Applications menu: 

- **App-based MFA:** You can generate a Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) using an authentication app like Google Authenticator, Okta Verify, or Microsoft Authenticator. For more details, see [Enroll for app-based MFA](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/multi-factor-authentication-mfa/get-started-with-mfa/enroll-for-app-based-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).
- **Email-based MFA:** You will receive a verification code via email each time you log in. This will be the default method unless you opt for app-based MFA. For more details, see topic [Enroll for email-based MFA](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/multi-factor-authentication-mfa/get-started-with-mfa/enroll-for-email-based-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).





For information on the corresponding APIs, see topic [MFA Setup APIs](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/authentication-api/access-token-authentication/mfa-setup-apis?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

For additional details, see our full announcement [Multi-Factor Authentication Now Available](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/multi-factor-authentication-now-available?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

> **Note:** Reltio starts to enforce MFA enablement automatically on 04-Nov-2024. For more details, see topic [Enable MFA](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/administer-system/system-administration-at-a-glance/access-management-at-a-glance/access-management-operation/authentication/multi-factor-authentication-mfa/get-started-with-mfa/enable-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Clients restricted by tenant**

Say goodbye to customer-specific client access and hello to improved security with tenant-specific clients. Previously, each client could access all tenants under their corresponding customer. Now, you can specify the tenants that clients may access, ensuring access segregation among your environments. Existing clients remain unchanged; you have the option to explicitly remove individual tenants from them to restrict their access. For more information, see this Console UI topic [Add new client](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/security-applications/client-credentials-at-a-glance/manage-client-credentials/add-new-client?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and this API topic [Create a customer client](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/authentication-api/application-client-management-apis/create-a-customer-client?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Reminder: Migrate service accounts from password to client credentials authentication**

Just a reminder to start migrating your service accounts to client credentials as soon as possible. This is crucial for ensuring the continuous operation of your automated processes and integrations, as well as maintaining security and compliance. For more details, see topic [Migrating service accounts from password to client credentials authentication](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/enhance-your-security-with-single-sign-on-sso-and-prepare-for-multi-factor-authentication-mfa/migrating-service-accounts-from-password-to-client-credentials-authentication?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Single Sign-On (SSO)/Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) implementation dates extended**

We've changed the dates for implementing Single Sign-On (SSO)/Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) feature. For more information, see topic [Enhance your security with Single Sign-On (SSO) and prepare for Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/enhance-your-security-with-single-sign-on-sso-and-prepare-for-multi-factor-authentication-mfa?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## Improved Role Based Access Control (RBAC) for RDM Data

**Granular role-based permissions**

Permissions are now reflected across the Reltio Connected Data Platform UI drop-downs and API responses that expose RDM lookup values. Users can only access information they are authorized to view or modify.

**Improved data visibility**

The RDM UI respects RBAC settings, with both the Lookup Types (including Hierarchy View and Activity Log) and Export page filtered based on user permissions. This ensures that users have visibility only into the data they are permitted to see.
