## Enhanced Delta Payload Streaming

The Reltio platform streams message into an external queue or topic in JSON format for consumption in downstream apps. This enhancement simplifies the downstream integrations.

The new Snapshot with delta payload type sends fixed fields in snapshot format and updated fields in delta format in streamed messages, thus:

- Improving data accuracy and integrity by ensuring consistent inclusion of values when streaming changed object attributes ("deltas").
- Streamlining integrations by supporting snapshot-selected fields along with delta streaming—no need for separate API calls.
- Enhancing operational efficiency by reducing complexity and simplifying data workflows.
- Simplifying downstream processing by accessing standard fields that are otherwise unavailable in delta streaming.

## Data Modeler Enhancements

The Data Modeler creates the blueprint for the way you organize elements of your data, such as individuals, organizations, and locations as well as how these entities interact. These enhancements streamline the process for managing multiple attributes at once rather than one-by-one and defining interaction in the Console:

**Manage multiple attributes in bulk with Edit Mode**

The new Edit Mode on the **Data Modeler Entity Attributes** page makes it quicker and easier to add, update multiple attributes for an entity in a single Save operation, providing:

- Ease of Use: Perform complex tasks in an intuitive user interface (UI), allowing non-technical users to easily manage attributes.
- Enhanced control: Easily add, edit, data model attributes directly from the UI.
- Time saving: Consolidate multiple changes into a single save operation.

**Interactions configuration**

Unlock valuable insights by defining Interaction types in the new Data Modeler Interaction Types page:

- Simplified configuration process to create and manage interactions and related objects through an intuitive data modeler interface.
- Enhanced visibility and control: Gain easier access to view and manage individual interaction components.
- Eliminate the need for L3 layer configuration to create interactions with properties such as URI, label, description, and more.

## Configure partial overrides for specific nested attributes in your business configuration

The `enableNestedPartialOverride` option determines whether the `Entities API` partially overrides nested attributes when you update an entity. Previously, you could only set this option at the tenant level, so it applied globally to all nested attributes in that tenant. Now, you can also configure this option for specific nested attributes in the business configuration. If you don't define this option at the attribute level, the API uses the tenant level configuration as a fallback, providing flexibility in managing nested attribute.

## Hub user interface enhancements

We've heard you! Now see the changes we've made to improve your experience in the Hub:

**Persist tabular view of relationship facet in profile page**

Previously, the Hierarchy facet in the Hub Profile view showed only the relation type and the start and end date attributes for relationships. You can now configure specific relationship attributes to display in this facet, for example:

- AffiliationSubType
- HierarchyCode
- AdditionalAttributes



For more information, see topic[Exploring the Hierarchy Management facet](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/model-data/data-modeling-at-a-glance/data-modeling-operation/define-hierarchies/exploring-the-hierarchy-management-facet?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Pinned and ignored attributes in Advanced search UI**

The options we introduced in a [2024.1 release](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/release-notes-at-a-glance/2024.1-release-notes/2024.1-weekly-release-notes?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) to filter profiles by pinned and ignored attributes are now also available in the Advanced Search UI. For more information, see topic [Exploring the Advanced Search](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/search/search-at-a-glance/search-navigation/exploring-the-advanced-search?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs). For the API details, see topics [Filtering Entities](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/entity-management-apis/entity-management-apis-at-a-glance/entities-api/get-entity/filtering-entities?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Relations Filtering](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/relation-management-apis/relation-management-apis-at-a-glance/relations-api/relations-filtering?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Visible Attributes in Profile view**

When editing, suggesting, or viewing a profile, do you want attributes without values to show up in the Profile view? Configure your UI to include the `alwaysVisible` option for the attributes you want visible in all modes. This option applies to the Collaborative Profile Creation as well. For more information, see topic [Profiles at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/hub/profiles-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Directional arrows in Relationship UI**

In the Hub Profile Relationship view, arrows depict relationships between the start and the end entity. We've corrected an error where the arrow directions and labels were inconsistent. Now the labels match the direction. For more information, see topic [Detailed View of the Related entity](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/hub/profiles-at-a-glance/profile-perspectives-tabs/profile-perspectives-navigation/relationships-perspective/detailed-view-of-the-related-entity?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Streamlined Collaborative Profile Creation**

Have you used the Collaborative Profile Creation feature, and its authoring workflow, to create profiles? Well, we've streamlined this process to make it even easier to accept or reject workflows. Now, instead of having to navigate to the notification **Inbox**, reviewers and approvers can approve or reject them directly in the Profile view. For more information, see topic [Suggest and save profiles using the authoring workflow](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/manage-profiles/profile-management-at-a-glance/profile-management-operation/add-a-profile-using-collaborative-profile-creation-wizard/suggest-and-save-profiles-using-the-authoring-workflow?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.3.1.0 weekly release notes | 28-Oct-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.3.1.0 weekly release.

**Welcome to the Reltio Data Cloud**

Our platform's name was Reltio Connected Data Platform and the focus was on tackling data silos and enabling data unification across enterprises. We've refreshed our name to **Reltio Data Cloud**, reflecting the limitless potential of unified enterprise data. This rebranding emphasizes our core strengths: entity resolution, multi-domain MDM, and real-time Customer 360, all while maintaining the robust capabilities you rely on. For the announcement, see [this blog post](https://www.reltio.com/blogs/reltio-data-cloud-powering-enterprise-data-in-the-age-of-ai/).

**Preparing for Nov 4 Security Enforcement Webinar**

Join us on October 29, 2024, for our final webinar as we approach the enforcement of Reltio's new security requirements on November 4, 2024. This session will reinforce key details, highlight new capabilities, review preventive measures, and provide final guidance on service account procedures and MFA setup. We're here to ensure you are fully prepared for a seamless transition while maintaining robust data security.

Here is [the registration form](https://reltio.zoom.us/meeting/register/tJMpd-uvrD4tHtTO8KTIzusXMYJwrpZ_dm25#/registration) and [the recorded event](https://community.reltio.com/blogs/sara-brams-miller/2024/10/29/community-show).

**Data Loader APIs available in China**

You can now use Data Loader APIs to load data into your tenants available from our China data center. For more details, see topic [Get ready for Data Loader](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/tenant-management-applications/data-loader-at-a-glance/get-ready-for-data-loader?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and the [Data Loader API](https://developer.reltio.com/private/swagger.htm?module=Data%20Ingestion#/Data%20Load%20Job).

# 2024.3.2.0 weekly release notes | 04-Nov-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.3.2.0 weekly release.

**Enhanced filtering in Survivorship Rules**

Survivorship filters now support the `in` and `notin` operators, enabling you to compare attributes against multiple values efficiently. Instead of chaining multiple `equals` and `or` conditions, you can now use `in` and `notin` to streamline filters when matching against lists of values. For more information, see this section on Survivorship Rules [Survivorship Rules](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/resolve-potential-matches/potential-matching-at-a-glance/potential-matching-navigation/design-survivorship-rules/survivorship-rules?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.3.3.0 weekly release notes | 11-Nov-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.3.3.0 weekly release.

**Holiday release freeze**

We understand you expect very high availability and trouble free operations during the Q4 peak period, which for 2024-2025 has been identified as November 18 through January 6, 2026 (inclusive). To support you during this crucial period we are making the following operational changes:

- We've evaluated all major change activities during this period and assessed them for impact. We'll make no major changes at the application or the infrastructure layer during this window for our retail customers.
- We'll pause weekly releases for all customers during the following weeks:
  - November 18, 2024 - December 2, 2024
  - December 23, 2024 - January 6, 2025
- We continue to proactively monitor the Reltio systems to ensure availability and performance are uninterrupted.
- We'll provide Emergency Bug Fixes for extremely urgent issues for which no workaround is possible or in case a service is unavailable.





Contact your Reltio Customer Success Manager (CSM) to address any questions you have regarding our support during the upcoming holiday season.

**Mulesoft connector supports Mule runtime engine 4.6.0 and Java 17**

The latest Mulesoft connector (2.5.0) now supports Mule Runtime Engine 4.6.0 and Java 17. This upgrade enhances performance, security, and API capabilities, aligning with third-party vendor updates that phase out Java 8. While there's no immediate impact on existing applications, we recommend you begin upgrading to Java 17 to ensure compatibility with integration apps, connectors, and API proxies dependent on Java. For more details, see topic [Upgrade Java for the Reltio Connector for MuleSoft](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/data-integrations/ipaas-connectors-at-a-glance/reltio-connector-for-mulesoft-at-a-glance/reltio-connector-for-mulesoft-set-up/test-a-project-with-the-reltio-connector-for-mulesoft/upgrade-java-for-the-reltio-connector-for-mulesoft?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Reltio Cleanser update Nov 2024**

We've updated the Reltio Address Cleanser with improvements to the verification process and the quality of the results. Additionally, we've updated the data for 42 countries. For more details, see topic [Reltio Address Cleanser update - Nov 2024](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/reltio-address-cleanser-update---nov-2024?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.3.4.0 weekly release notes | 09-Dec-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.3.4.0 weekly release.

## Meet our reimagined Documentation Portal

Get to the content you need at speed. Smarter and more intuitive–we've reimagined the Reltio Documentation Portal to get you to the information you need at higher speed, while offering a clean and visually appealing interface.

| Reltio Documentation Portal | Reltio Documentation Portal |
| --- | --- |
| Before | Now |
| *Image: i-rn-portal-old.gif* | *Image: i-rn-portal-new.gif* |





**Navigation optimization**

Get to the right content in fewer clicks with our revamped structure: 

- Platform resources: Exploratory or occasional reference material on:
  - Reltio: Get to know our approach to trusted, interoperable data.
  - Products: Meet the Reltio Data Cloud™, Reltio Entity Resolution™, Reltio Multidomain Master Data Management (MDM), and Reltio Customer 360™.
  - Developer resources: Get usage guidance on REST APIs.
- 

  Personalized pathways: Tailored guidance for frequent, in-depth tasks: 

  - Roles: Are you a Data Steward configuring data models? Walk this way! A Developer integrating APIs? We have your size! Whatever your role with the Reltio Data Cloud, we’ll set you down the right path.
  - Applications: Already know that you want to view profiles in the Hub or define your data model in the Console? Quick links get you there efficiently.
  - Objectives: Know what you need to get done, but not how to do it in our platform? Find content curated for specific goals, such as data integration or system administration.

**Refined design lines**

Our curated design makes finding and using documentation intuitive: 

- Color-coded tiles and icons: Distinguish platform resources from personalized paths.
- Consistent section layouts: Navigate predictably through topics arranged by architecture, setup, navigation, operation, and resources.





This isn’t just a facelift—it’s a shift toward a user-focused, dynamic content platform. Think of it as evolving from a basic repository to a smart, adaptive resource that grows with your needs and Reltio’s innovations. For more information, see topic [Get to know Reltio in Documentation Portal](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-to-know-reltio-in-documentation-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

> **Important:** The new structure and search make finding content easier. While redirects from the old portal are active, we may limit them if performance issues arise. Bookmark topics in the new portal for quick access—see [Search content](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-to-know-reltio-in-documentation-portal/search-content?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs), for details.

## See what's new in this weekly release

**Access Usage Reporting with ROLE_API**

Users with the ROLE_API role can now access the Usage Reporting application, which was previously available only to users with the ROLE_ADMIN_TENANT role. Use this application to gain insights into API Calls, storage consumption, and consolidated profiles for your tenants. For more details, see topic [Usage Reporting at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/tenant-management-applications/usage-reporting-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Consolidate your relationships**

With the latest relationship consolidation enhancement, you can now manage relationship crosswalks more effectively. By enabling the `contributorCrosswalkSingleSourceUpdateMode` flag at the tenant or `contributorCrosswalkSingleSourceUpdateMode` relationship level, you ensure the system consolidates duplicate crosswalks from the same contributor, keeping only the most recent entry.

This helps in keeping the count of relationship crosswalks low preventing you to reach the crosswalk limit. This is specially useful when your source system creates new database entries instead updating existing entries for each update

When enabled, this feature identifies crosswalks with the same start and end objects, contributor, and relationship type, and automatically overwrites older entries with the latest one. The default behavior remains unchanged unless you explicitly enable the flag, so you can adopt this enhancement at your own pace. For more information, see topic [Consolidating relationship crosswalks](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/relation-management-apis/relation-management-apis-at-a-glance/relations-api/create-relationships/consolidating-relationship-crosswalks?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.3.5.0 weekly release notes | 16-Dec-2024

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.3 weekly release.

**Improved profile attribute handling for cardinality 1**

Earlier, when editing a profile, you could add multiple values for an attribute with maximum cardinality set to 1. Now, you can only add a single value as you'll no longer see the "+" sign next to such attributes. For more information, see topics [Editing profiles](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/manage-profiles/profile-management-at-a-glance/profile-management-operation/editing-profiles?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Attributes configuration](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/configuration-api/attributes-configuration?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).





**Message streaming parameter now available in Tenant Configuration**

Previously, you needed to raise a support ticket to enable or disable your message streaming to external queues. Now, you can lead the way. We've added the Message Streaming parameter to the Tenant Configuration self-service line-up. Enable or disable messaging across all queues, including hidden ones, directly under **Console > Tenant Management > Tenant Configuration**.

For more information, see topic [Tenant Configuration at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/tenant-management-applications/tenant-management-at-a-glance/tenant-configuration-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2024.3.6.0 weekly release notes | 13-Jan-2025

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2024.3.6.0 weekly release.

**Reltio Life Cycle Action now supports Google Cloud functions**

We now support Google Cloud functions in Life Cycle Action (LCA), expanding serverless integration options beyond AWS Lambda. You can now trigger custom data operations using Google Cloud services, simplifying lifecycle action management and enabling greater flexibility for automation.

For details, see topic [LCA implementation using Google functions](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/about-developer-resources/developer-resources-at-a-glance/customize-data-tasks-with-lcas/lca-implementation-using-google-functions?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Automated Bitbucket reviews for custom workflows**

We're deprecating manual reviews for custom workflow jars in favor of the automated Bitbucket approval process, effective February 10, 2025. This streamlined process offers faster approvals, eliminates manual intervention, and improves scalability.

For details, see topic [Custom workflow manual review replaced with automated Bitbucket process - Feb 2025](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/custom-workflow-manual-review-replaced-with-automated-bitbucket-process---feb-2025?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Improved support for system attributes in UI Modeler**

In the UI Modeler, you can now select system attributes when determining profile attributes to show or hide. Specifically, when you configure **Attributes to Display** or **Attributes to Hide** you can select `startDate`, `endDate`, `roles`, and `tags`. This minor enhancement is also available in the **Single Attribute View**, making it easier to manage attribute visibility as you no longer have to update the JSON configuration manually.

For context, see topic [Configure Collaborative Profile Creation for an entity type](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/configure-the-reltio-ui/ui-configuration-at-a-glance/configure-your-profile-pages/configure-collaborative-profile-creation-for-an-entity-type?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# Additional features and enhancements

Learn about key new features and enhancements introduced in this 2025.1 release.

Try these scoops of ice cream with the release cake!

## Data Loader enhancements

Take a look at the new Data Loader enhancements we have in store for you:

**Prioritize and pause/resume data loading jobs**

Take a look at the new `Data Loader API` endpoints to set a job's priority and to pause and resume jobs. This gives you better control over the job processing order and the loading sequence:

- 

  Change the priority of a job: Use the `/_priority` endpoint to 

  - Set the priority level to High, Normal, or Low to determine the order to process jobs. If multiple jobs have the same priority level, they are processed in order of their creation time.
  - Change a job's priority to a higher level than the job currently running to move it to the top of the processing queue. This pauses the job that was running.
- 

  Pause or resume a job: Use the `/_pause` endpoint to pause currently running jobs: 

  - Resume a previously paused job. It continues loading data from where it stopped. If you resume a job, it maintains its order of creation time. Even if there is a another job already running, if the resumed job has an earlier creation time it gets prioritized in the queue.

| Configuration required | No |

## Data Unification

Here's what we have in store for match and merge:

**Events for merge failures**

Previously, Reltio didn't generate an event for failed merge attempts due to system-imposed restrictions, For example, when exceeding crosswalk limits. Such failures occurred without notification, leaving you unaware of potential data integrity issues. Now, not only does the platform generate an event but it also logs merge failures in the Activity Log for visibility. You may send the events of type `ENTITIES_MERGE_FAILED` and `RELATIONS_MERGE_FAILED` to external queues for real-time monitoring and corrective action on failed merges.

**Min/ Max/ Frequency Survivorship Enhancement**

We improved our minimum and maximum survivorship strategies for nested attributes by introducing the optional flag `comparisonAttributeOvOnly`. Set it to true to compare only the OV value of a subnested attribute defined for comparison.

## Reltio Integration with Salesforce (on RIH)

**Batch Dispatch for Amazon SQS**

This feature introduces recipes for synchronizing data from Reltio to Salesforce using Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) queues and batch dispatch mechanisms. It improves processing logic for high scale and batch oriented workflows. It reduces tasks usage and has better throughput. We recommend to use these recipes as a the default for the near real time integration with Salesforce.

With this feature you are able to process events in batches of up to 200 events for optimized output. Processes only the most recent event in cases where multiple events exist for the same entity.

## Reltio Data Pipeline for Databricks

**Automatically update exported schema to Databricks warehouse**

Previously, schema evolution was only available for data exported in JSON format from the Reltio Data Pipeline for Databricks. We've enhanced the pipeline to support schema evolution for data in columns format. Now, Reltio Data Cloud automatically reflects the tenant data model updates in the exported data within your Databricks warehouse. 

If you have your Databricks warehouse in a private cloud and the DLT pipeline is running in continuous mode, we recommend you stop and restart it every time you perform updates in the schema.

**Performance improvement for Databricks Data Pipeline**

Previously, all data, regardless of type, were grouped together into a single file in your staging bucket. This created overhead in your pipeline, slowing down processing and making it harder to scale for large data volumes. Now, data is stored by type within your staging bucket, such as entities, relationships, and interactions. This change allows Databricks to process these files in parallel, streamlining data movement and improving pipeline performance during large data loads. 

New pipelines will automatically include these updates. As for existing pipelines, you can adopt the changes with a few simple steps.

## Match IQ moves to the history books

The **Match IQ** feature will be deprecated in the 2026.1 release. **Match IQ** is an ML-driven matching solution that refines models through an active learning process.

| What you need to know | What you need to know |
| --- | --- |
| Why are we deprecating it? | Because we heard your feedback:  - Training the model took too much time and effort. - You didn't want to answer the large number of training questions. - Those who trained Match IQ found rule-based matching just as effective. |
| What do you need to do? | If you use **Match IQ**, migrate to an alternative matching solution before 2026.1 to avoid disruptions. |
| Find out more | [Match IQ - Feb 2026](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/match-iq---feb-2026?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) |

These key new features and enhancements really take the cake!

## Effortlessly access Reltio data in Microsoft Fabric

You can now securely access AI-ready data from Reltio in near real time directly within Microsoft Fabric, without moving or copying data—no ETL required. This zero-copy integration eliminates the need for ETL, allowing you to build and consume high-performance analytics, BI solutions, and AI applications with ease.

With trusted, remediated data available in Microsoft Fabric, you can:

- Streamline data sharing to power BI, analytics, and AI apps without manual data movement.
- Enhance security and governance by eliminating duplicate data copies and reducing compliance risks.
- Lower operational costs and reduce complexity by avoiding data replication and manual ETL pipelines.

The Early Access (EA) program for this feature starts February 24, 2025.

## Reltio Lightspeed Data Delivery Network

Access trusted core data with consistent, near-zero latency, and high availability for critical operational and analytical systems using Reltio LightSpeed™ Data Delivery Network.

Our ultra-speed offering delivers data in under 50 milliseconds with 99.99% uptime when deployed across multiple regions. Designed for instant, reliable retrieval, Reltio LightSpeed™ Data Delivery Network deploys regional instances of precomputed, query-optimized datasets to ensure unmatched performance. An optional add-on enables automated cross-regional dataset replication, providing seamless failover and uninterrupted operations during regional outages.

## A match made in metadata with Reltio Integration for Alation

The journey continues! We're thrilled to expand our lineup of data catalog integrations with the Reltio Integration for Alation. Seamlessly connect Reltio to Alation's data catalog to unlock data discovery, lineage, and governance capabilities:

- Seamless Metadata Sync: Automatically fetch and update entity and relationship metadata from Reltio to Alation.
- Enhanced Data Management: Leverage Alation's advanced tools, including its business glossary and data lineage features, to get the most value from your Reltio data.
- Selective Enablement: Enable the integration on a tenant-by-tenant basis to suit specific organizational needs.

The integration retrieves the latest entity and relationship metadata from your Reltio tenant's configuration and executes Alation APIs to create, update, or soft delete assets in the Alation data catalog. Keep your Reltio and Alation data in lock step by resyncing data on demand or scheduling automatic updates using Reltio Integration Hub (RIH) recipes.

## Safeguard sensitive data with Data Masking

Protect sensitive data with Reltio's new Data Masking feature, designed to safeguard personally identifiable information (PII) and sensitive personal information (SPII). With configurable granularity and role-based access control (RBAC), Data Masking ensures compliance with data privacy regulations while enabling secure data unification.

- Configure which attributes to mask and who can unmask them.
- Define access to unmasked data via Reltio UI or APIs, based on your evolving needs.
- Match and merge records using PII data while adhering to the "principle of least privilege."

Maintain consistent metadata across Reltio and Collibra for unified data governance and management:

- **Unified Business Glossary:** Fetch business glossary descriptions from Collibra into Reltio to ensure consistent definitions across systems.

## Bulk up match reviews—faster, smarter, easier

Say goodbye to tedious, one-at-a-time match resolution! With **Bulk Match Review**, you can now resolve potential matches faster and more efficiently than ever before. Designed with your productivity in mind, this feature helps you streamline your workflows and maintain high-quality, trusted data:

- Resolve Matches in Bulk: Select and resolve up to 100 potential matches at once, cutting down the time you spend reviewing and taking action on match candidates.
- Work Smarter, Not Harder: Use powerful filtering options to narrow down match lists and focus on the ones that matter most.
- Boost Data Confidence: Easily ensure data accuracy and reduce false positives without being bogged down by manual review tasks.

Navigate to the **Bulk Match Review** page, in the **Hub**, to get started. With just a few clicks, you can filter potential matches, select the ones you want to resolve, and mark them to merge or not—a simple process designed to make your life easier.

The Early Access (EA) program for this feature starts February 24, 2025.

# Reltio MCP Server launch | 08-May-2025

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in the Reltio MCP Server release.

**Meet Reltio MCP Server: Real-time AI data access, zero friction**

The Reltio Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server is now available, offering a secure, open-standard API gateway that enables AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and orchestration tools to interact with trusted master data in real time. Think of MCP as the USB-C for AI agents — plug in and go.

With both open-source and fully managed editions, the MCP Server simplifies integration by eliminating the need for custom connectors or static exports. It supports Agentic capabilities, allowing AI agents to autonomously perform data-related tasks such as resolving matches, enriching profiles, or validating records.

This release accelerates AI adoption by streamlining secure data access, reducing operational costs, and grounding AI in trusted, up-to-date data.

For more details, see [Reltio Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/ai-integrations/reltio-model-context-protocol-mcp-server-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2025.1.2.0 weekly release notes | 10-Mar-2025

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2025.1.2.0 weekly release.

**Interactions Loading... Skip the Schema!**

We've simplified how you load interactions into your tenants. Previously, to load interactions, you needed to define a schema. Now, you're able to load interactions with no defined schema. This means that you aren't required to map attributes, allowing you for a quicker setup before the job starts.

This enhancement is available in the **Console > Data Loader** application and in the `Data Loader API`.

For more details, see [Load interactions without defining a data model](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/load-and-export-data/data-loading-at-a-glance/data-loading-operation/load-data-with-data-loader/load-interactions-into-a-tenant/load-interactions-without-defining-a-data-model?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Streamlining Security Configuration with Password Policy Inheritance**

Customer password policies now inherit the following properties from the default policy if not explicitly defined:

- `numberOfFailedLoginAttempts`
- `numberOfFailedMFALoginAttempts`
- `inactivePeriodInDays`





This simplifies configuration by allowing you to focus on the specific settings you want to customize, while maintaining consistency with the default security standards. For more details, see [Set customer password policy](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/customer-password-policy-apis/set-customer-password-policy?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2025.1.3.0 weekly release notes | 18-Mar-2025

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2025.1.3.0 weekly release.

**Deprecation of AWS Access Key and Secret Authentication on Reltio-Owned AWS Resources**

We are enhancing security by transitioning from AWS access key and secret authentication to IAM role-based authentication using AssumeRole to access Reltio-owned AWS resources. This change aligns with AWS best practices, reducing credential exposure and improving access management. If you currently use AWS access keys to access Reltio-owned AWS resources, we recommend transitioning to IAM roles as soon as possible.

For more details, see [AWS access key and secret in favor of IAM roles for Reltio-owned resources](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/aws-access-key-and-secret-in-favor-of-iam-roles-for-reltio-owned-resources?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**No More Null Surprises! Get Unique Surrogate Keys Every Time**

We've introduced a new `generationLogic` parameter, named `generateUidWhenAllOvMissing`, to improve surrogate crosswalk key generation. Previously, when all attributes for an entity lacked operational values (OVs), the system generated an MD5 hash using `null` values, leading to potential duplicates. Now, with this new parameter, a UUID is generated instead, ensuring unique keys even when all OV values are missing.

This update helps prevent unintended entity merges and improves data consistency. It's available in Surrogate Crosswalks configuration for all tenants.

For more details, see [Configuring surrogate keys](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/model-data/data-modeling-at-a-glance/data-modeling-operation/define-crosswalks-for-data-sources/configuring-surrogate-keys?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2025.1.10.0 weekly release notes | 12-May-2025

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2025.1.10.0 weekly release.

**DVF service support for crosswalk level validation**

You can now run Data Validation Functions (DVFs) on specific source systems, not just Operational Values. This helps you pinpoint and fix data quality issues at the source.

Use the new `applyOn` setting to target crosswalk values from selected sources. Default behavior remains unchanged for existing DVFs.

For more information, see topics [Apply data validation functions at crosswalk level](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-operation/define-data-validation-functions/apply-data-validation-functions-at-crosswalk-level?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Define Data Validation Functions](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-operation/define-data-validation-functions?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Fine-tune fallback survivorship with source-specific control**

You now have more control over attribute resolution when fallback strategies are triggered. The `sourcesForOV` parameter is now supported within fallback survivorship strategies. This lets you specify a different set of source systems to use for fallback logic — separate from those used in the primary strategy.

Here's what's new:

- You can define a `sourcesForOV` list specifically for the fallback strategy.
- The fallback list can differ completely from the primary strategy's `sourcesForOV`.
- When fallback is triggered, only the sources listed in the fallback `sourcesForOV` are used.
- If `sourcesForOV` is not defined for the fallback, the system continues to use its existing fallback behavior.
- If earlier fallback levels filtered out values, only those filtered values are considered — but with the full original set of their crosswalks.
- If a fallback level returns no winners, the filtered values from the last level with non-zero winners are reused — again with their full original crosswalks.





This enhancement provides more precise control over trusted source prioritization, especially in complex data stewardship scenarios involving conditional survivorship.

For additional information, see [Survivorship Rules](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/resolve-potential-matches/potential-matching-at-a-glance/potential-matching-navigation/design-survivorship-rules/survivorship-rules?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2025.1.11.0 weekly release notes | 19-May-2025

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2025.1.10.0 weekly release.

**Read-After-Write Consistency with Synchronous Updates in Reltio Lightspeed**

Now you can guarantee real-time visibility for critical data writes. 

We've introduced a new capability in the Reltio Lightspeed™ Data Delivery Network that lets you enable synchronous predicate index updates — so your data changes are instantly available through Reltio Lightspeed queries.

With this enhancement, you can configure read-after-write consistency at multiple levels:

- Across your entire tenant
- For specific entity types
- Or per individual API requestThat means no more stale data, retry logic, or delayed lookups in real-time flows like onboarding, fraud detection, or mobile registration.

> **Note:** This feature is available to limited users through the Reltio Early Access (EA) program. Interested in finding out more about this feature or participating in our EA program? Get details in topic Early Access (EA) features.

For more information, see [Understanding synchronous updates in Reltio Lightspeed](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/about-developer-resources/developer-resources-at-a-glance/reltio-lightspeed-data-delivery-network-at-a-glance/understanding-synchronous-updates-in-reltio-lightspeed?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Strengthen your security: password length enforcement is here**

We're tightening up password security with a new policy enforcement. Starting May 19, 2025, all custom password policies must require passwords between **10 and 64 characters**. This aligns with best-practice standards like **NIST SP 800-63b** and **OWASP**. 

If your current custom policy is out of range, you won't be able to change security parameters until the password length is corrected. Ensure to configure this parameter correctly the next time you make changes to the password policy.

For more information, see [Set customer password policy](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/customer-password-policy-apis/set-customer-password-policy?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and for any queries, [Get help in Support Portal](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Generate external IDs automatically for policy configurations**

You no longer need to manually create or request external IDs for your cross-account role mappings. With our new API endpoint, Reltio generates a unique `externalId` for you — instantly and securely. 

This makes configuring roles and policies across tenants faster and less error-prone.

For more information, see [Generate external ID](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/tools-api/generate-external-id?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

The Segmentation feature now allows easy tracking of segments and profiles. You can now:

- View all tenant segments in the Profile Stats Dashboard





For more information, see topics [Create a segment](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/manage-profiles/profile-management-at-a-glance/profile-management-operation/work-with-segments/create-a-segment?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs), [Segments facet](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/manage-profiles/profile-management-at-a-glance/profile-navigation/profile-attributes/segments-facet?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Data insights operation](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/explore-data-insights/data-insights-at-a-glance/data-insights-operation?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Stream Reltio data directly to Snowflake**

Say goodbye to maintaining buckets and Snowpipe scripts. With our new internal stage-based architecture for the Reltio Data Pipeline for Snowflake, your data flows securely and automatically, straight from Reltio to Snowflake. That means less setup, no external staging, and faster access to clean, trusted data.This streamlined pipeline architecture is now the recommended one for all new Snowflake integrations.

For more details, see [Reltio Data Pipeline for Snowflake (Direct Connect) architecture](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/data-integrations/data-pipelines-at-a-glance/reltio-data-pipeline-for-snowflake-at-a-glance/reltio-data-pipeline-for-snowflake-direct-connect-architecture?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Unified task parameter for distributed jobs**

We've standardized the way you define task execution across distributed jobs. Previously, the `Bulk Delete Entities API` used a unique parameter, `distributedTasksPartsCount`, to control parallel execution. Now, it aligns with all other distributed jobs by using the common `taskPartsCount` parameter. 

This change makes it easier to manage and document distributed task behavior consistently, no more switching between parameter names across jobs.

For more information, see topic [Bulk Delete Entities](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/entity-management-apis/entity-management-apis-at-a-glance/entities-api/delete-entity/bulk-delete-entities?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2025.1.14.0 weekly release notes | 09-Jun-2025

Use the new `updateRelationStartEnd` task to bulk update the start or end entity of existing relationships, without having to delete and recreate the relationships again. Just use a filter to select the appropriate relationship and specify the new `entityid` to repoint the relationships to the new entity id.

For more information, see [Bulk update relation start or end entities](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/system-administration-apis/system-administration-apis-at-a-glance/tasks-api/bulk-update-relation-start-or-end-entities?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Survivorship rule used to determine OV value**

Use the new `showAppliedSurvivorshipRules` parameter in the Entities API and Relations API to reveal the survivorship rule that determined each OV value.

For more information, see [Get Entity](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/entity-management-apis/entity-management-apis-at-a-glance/entities-api/get-entity?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Get Relationship](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/relation-management-apis/relation-management-apis-at-a-glance/relations-api/get-relationship?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Bring clarity, compliance, and context with required workflow comments**

You can now configure comments as mandatory during workflow startup and on specific task actions — such as Reject — to ensure full audit traceability. When enabled, users are prompted with a pop-up in the Inbox to provide comments, ensuring decisions are never made without context. 

This enhancement helps enforce internal policies, support compliance requirements, and maintain a clean, transparent process history.

Note that this feature isn't currently supported in the Hub UI. If a workflow requires mandatory comments at startup or during task actions, attempts to initiate or act on the workflow via the Hub UI fail, as users cannot enter comments in that interface.

For more information, see the `commentRequired` property in [Business process definition overview](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/manage-workflow-tasks/workflow-management-at-a-glance/workflow-management-reference/business-process-definition-overview?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) and [Working With Tasks](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/manage-workflow-tasks/workflow-management-at-a-glance/workflow-management-operation/working-with-tasks?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Value Based Priority survivorship strategy**

With the new `ValueBasedPriority` survivorship strategy, you can define a prioritized list of attribute values. During profile consolidation, survivorship selects operational values from this list in the order you specify, thus ensuring the values most important to your business take precedence. For more information, see topic [Value-based priority survivorship strategy](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/resolve-potential-matches/potential-matching-at-a-glance/potential-matching-navigation/design-survivorship-rules/value-based-priority-survivorship-strategy?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

We've updated the Reltio Address Cleanser with global data refreshes for 80+ countries, targeted parsing improvements, and API-level enhancements. This release also includes country rebuilds for Bulgaria, France, Chile, and Ecuador, along with geographic data hierarchy corrections in Australia, Canada, Mexico, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. These changes improve parsing accuracy, match scoring, casing preservation, and address verification results.

For more details, see [Reltio Address Cleanser update - Jun 2025](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/reltio-address-cleanser-update---jun-2025?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Keep traffic private on Azure**

Running Reltio in Microsoft Azure? You can now route tenant traffic over *Azure Private Link*, the same rock-solid pattern we've offered for AWS. Spin up a private endpoint in your VNet, drop in the service alias we provide, and keep every packet on Microsoft's backbone — no public internet, lower latency, and simpler compliance. 

For more details, see [Configuring Azure Private Link](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/additional-subscriptions-at-a-glance/reltio-private-link/configuring-azure-private-link?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2025.1.19.0 weekly release notes | 14-Jul-2025

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2025.1.19.0 weekly release.

**Reltio AgentFlow**™** MCP Server is now available for your production AI Agents**

Reltio AgentFlow MCP Server is now Generally Available to interface between your AI apps and Reltio trusted, unified data. This is the natural evolution of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server we announced on May 8th. Now, you have two ways of connecting your AI Agents to Reltio depending on your development stage.

With this release, you now have two options:

- **Reltio Developer MCP Server** – Open-source and self-hosted. Ideal for prototyping and trials.
- **Reltio AgentFlow MCP Server** – Fully managed by Reltio. Delivers secure, governed, and role-aware access to trusted data for AI agents and orchestration tools without the infrastructure burden. Designed for enterprise production scale.





For more information, see [Reltio Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/ai-integrations/reltio-model-context-protocol-mcp-server-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs), [Reltio AgentFlow™ MCP Server](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/ai-integrations/reltio-model-context-protocol-mcp-server-at-a-glance/reltio-agentflow-mcp-server?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs), [Authentication flow for the AgentFlow MCP Server](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/ai-integrations/reltio-model-context-protocol-mcp-server-at-a-glance/authentication-flow-for-the-agentflow-mcp-server?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs), and [MCP tools](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/ai-integrations/reltio-model-context-protocol-mcp-server-at-a-glance/mcp-tools?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# 2025.1.20.0 weekly release notes | 21-Jul-2025

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2025.1.20.0 weekly release.

**Pick your perfect match with FERN modes**

Reltio's Flexible Entity Resolution Network (FERN) just got personal. Instead of flipping a single on/off switch, you can now choose the mode that fits your goal — **FERN enhanced discovery** for prioritizing existing matches, **FERN for data steward** for uncovering overlooked match pairs, or **Full Mode** for the best of both worlds. Each mode comes pre-tuned out of the box, yet you're free to adjust thresholds and mappings whenever you need.

Already running FERN? A version-aware upgrade notification appears in the same table row when a newer match model is available. One click applies the latest AI/ML improvements and unlocks the new mode selector — no downtime, no guesswork. Skip the toggle and match on your terms.

For more information, see [FERN with Modes](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/configuration-applications/ai-powered-flexible-entity-resolution-network-fern-model-based-matching-at-a-glance/fern-based-matching/fern-with-modes?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

****



**Get cleaner, smarter location data — now with enhanced controls**

You can now use new server options and output fields to better manage how address data is matched, parsed, and formatted. Configure minimum match thresholds, enforce country-specific matching rules, and generate structured address format outputs. 

We've also added dozens of new address output fields and status indicators, so you can inspect how each component was verified or corrected. This gives you richer insight into address cleansing results across regions and formats.

For more information, see [Address cleanse options](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-reference/out-of-the-box-cleanse-functions/address-cleanser/reltio-address-cleansing-parameters/address-cleanse-options?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs), [Mapping output attribute](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-reference/out-of-the-box-cleanse-functions/address-cleanser/mapping-input-and-output-attributes/mapping-output-attribute?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs), and [Address cleansing status fields](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/cleanse-and-verify-data/data-cleansing-at-a-glance/data-cleansing-reference/out-of-the-box-cleanse-functions/address-cleanser/address-cleansing-properties/address-cleansing-status-fields?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Grouping entity types for easier discovery**

Assign groups to entity types to organize them by data domain. In the Hub UI, grouped entity types now appear together when searching records or creating a new profile — making it easier to navigate and manage your data model. For more information, see topic [Entity type grouping](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/what-does-reltio-do/what-reltio-does-at-a-glance/data-unification-and-mdm-at-a-glance/data-unification-and-mdm-in-detail/reltio-information-model/data-model/reltio-object-types/reltio-entity-types/entity-type-grouping?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# Release update | 08-Aug-2025

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2025.1.22.0 weekly release.

**What's new — documentation updates only, more to come soon**

We're continuing to resolve critical issues and prepare upcoming features. While no new platform functionality has been released and there are no changes to development, test, or production environments this cycle, we're getting closer.

In the meantime, we've added new documentation to help you make the most of the existing capabilities:

**Build your own MCP client with open-source examples**

We've published new documentation and Python-based examples to help developers connect to the Reltio AgentFlow MCP Server. You'll learn how to configure the server endpoint, authenticate using OAuth 2.0, and use streamable HTTP to build lightweight, production-ready clients.

For more information, see [Build a custom MCP client for AgentFlow](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/ai-integrations/reltio-model-context-protocol-mcp-server-at-a-glance/build-a-custom-mcp-client-for-agentflow?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Configure the Claude app to connect to Reltio AgentFlow MCP Server**

You can now configure the Claude desktop app to securely connect to the Reltio MCP Server using a bearer token and npx-based invocation. Setup instructions include endpoint formatting, environment variables, JSON configuration, and troubleshooting for common errors like token expiry and IP allowlisting.

For more information, see [Configure Claude to connect with Reltio AgentFlow MCP Server](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/ai-integrations/reltio-model-context-protocol-mcp-server-at-a-glance/configure-claude-to-connect-with-reltio-agentflow-mcp-server?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Explore all velocity packs for Intelligent 360**

Customer 360 is now Intelligent 360, and it ships with Velocity Packs for B2B, B2C, Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, and Life Sciences. These velocity packs reuse the same data model from MDM Velocity Packs, but now include Interaction types for added customer insight.

Go live faster with prebuilt entities, relationships, and interactions, all in one place. For more information, see [velocity packs](https://docs.reltio.com/en/products/reltio-intelligent-360/reltio-intelligent-360-at-a-glance/reltio-intelligent-360-reference/reltio-intelligent-360-velocity-packs?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

# Release update | 15-Aug-2025

**More time to test — we're moving to twice-monthly releases**

We're updating our release cadence starting **Friday, August 22, 2025**. Reltio will move from weekly releases to **twice-monthly updates**.

This change reflects your feedback requesting more time between updates for validation. Dev and Test tenants will be updated every other Friday, with Production tenants updated the following Friday. **Keep your graphs flowing — even if credits run out**

When building relationship graphs with the Get Hops API, you can now get partial results even if the credit limit is reached. Just add `returnDataAnyway=true` to your request. The response includes `dataComplete=false` to indicate incomplete data.

# 2025.1.22.0 bi-weekly release notes | 05-Sep-2025

Learn about the new features and enhancements introduced in this 2025.1.22.0 release.

> **Note:** Stage 3 deployment to the Production (PRD) tenant has been rescheduled from August 29, 2025, to September 5, 2025.





**Deployment dates**

| Stage | Tenant type | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Development (DEV) | August 22, 2025 |
| 2 | Test (TEST) | August 25, 2025 |
| 3 | Production (PRD) | September 05, 2025 |

**Reltio Data Sharing with Microsoft Fabric is now GA**

Reltio Data Sharing with Microsoft Fabric is now generally available. You can securely access AI-ready and trusted data from Reltio in near real time directly within Microsoft Fabric, without moving or copying data; no ETL required.

This zero-copy integration enables you to build and consume analytics, BI solutions, and AI applications with trusted, governed data, while reducing compliance risks and avoiding the cost and complexity of data replication. It also enables you to access data in a simplified schema or a flattened format.

For more information, see [Reltio Data Sharing with Microsoft Fabric at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/data-integrations/reltio-data-sharing-at-a-glance/reltio-data-sharing-with-microsoft-fabric-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Data Pipelines now lives in Data Sharing**

In the Reltio **Console**, the **Data Pipelines** application has moved from its standalone location into the **Data Sharing** application of the **Tenant Management** group. 

This update brings **Data Share** (zero-copy access) and **Data Pipelines** (managed exports) together in one place. The functionality of **Data Pipelines** remains the same, only its location has changed.

| Reltio Console | Reltio Console |
| --- | --- |
| Before | After |
| *Image: i-reltio-console-2025-1-21-0.png* | *Image: i-reltio-console-2025-1-22-0.png* |



The applications you see in the**Console** depend on your Reltio Context Intelligence Platform subscriptions so you may not see all of the ones in these illustrative screenshots.

For more information, see [Data Sharing at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/console/tenant-management-applications/data-sharing-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**No more empty winners after unmerge**

Previously, when detaching the origin contributor from a profile with three or more contributors, Reltio could create a shell winner — an entity with no real-world counterpart — especially during manual unmerge or when unmerge logic was misconfigured. 

With the `NEW_WINNER_ELECTED_ON_ORIGIN_DETACHMENT` feature flag enabled, Reltio now ensures that when the origin contributor is detached, a real contributor is always elected as the new winner. The system selects the contributor with the oldest crosswalk load date, so the resulting profile remains meaningful and anchored to actual data.

For more information, see [Control winner re-election after origin contributor detachment](https://docs.reltio.com/en/objectives/resolve-potential-matches/potential-matching-at-a-glance/potential-matching-operation/unmerge-entity-records/control-winner-re-election-after-origin-contributor-detachment?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Unifying match count tools**

We've introduced a new mcp tool, `get_potential_matches_stats_tool` that brings together everything you need in one response. It reports total matches, breakdowns by entity type, and counts by match rule across all domains.

This new tool replaces the functionality of `get_total_matches_by_entity_type_tool` and `get_total_matches_tool`, which are now being deprecated.

For more information, see [MCP tools](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/ai-integrations/reltio-model-context-protocol-mcp-server-at-a-glance/mcp-tools?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**Reltio Address Cleanser update – August 2025**

We've updated the Reltio Address Cleanser with global data refreshes across 25+ countries. This release delivers a major rebuild for the Netherlands, introducing enhanced parsing that separates Premise and SubBuilding into distinct fields.

You'll also see targeted fixes for Great Britain, Spain, Vietnam, South Korea, and the U.S., resolving issues with flat numbers, PO Boxes, thoroughfares, and missing locality names. Additional API-level enhancements improve script cleansing, result-building performance, and consistency between batch and demo verification.

For more details, see [Reltio Address Cleanser update - Aug 2025](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/reltio-address-cleanser-update---aug-2025?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**No pipelines required - Resolve duplicates natively in Databricks**

Now available, Reltio Entity Resolution in Databricks. This production-grade ML solution lets you match **Individual** entity records directly inside your Databricks lakehouse — no data movement, no external MDM required. Clean, governed, and AI-ready data is just a notebook away.

For more information, see [Reltio Embedded Entity Resolution in Databricks at a glance](https://docs.reltio.com/en/products/reltio-entity-resolution/reltio-embedded-entity-resolution-in-databricks-at-a-glance?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

**D&B Connector now supports updateAttributeUpdateDates**

The D&B connector now supports the `updateAttributeUpdateDates` option. When set to true, the connector passes the parameter in API requests, and the Reltio platform updates the timestamps for attributes whose values have changed.

For more information, see [Get Organization Match](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/data-integration-apis/data-integration-apis-at-a-glance/db-connector-apis/get-organization-match?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs), [Get Detailed Profile](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/data-integration-apis/data-integration-apis-at-a-glance/db-connector-apis/get-detailed-profile?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs), and [Get Upward Account Hierarchy](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/data-integration-apis/data-integration-apis-at-a-glance/db-connector-apis/get-upward-account-hierarchy?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## New simplified UI configuration

You can now convert multiple UI configuration files into a single, unified configuration that's easier to manage. On the **Import/Export page of the UI Modeler**, when the old configuration format is detected, a message prompts you to convert. With one **click of a button**, the configuration is transformed into the new format using predefined logic — without losing any of your current settings.

## Survivorship defaults and fallback handling

We've enhanced the Survivorship capability to give you more control over how winning values are selected across your tenant. The following key enhancements expand what you can configure:

- Configurable default survivorship strategies - Set the default survivorship strategy at the tenant or object type level (entity or relationship). Object-level settings override tenant-level, with *Last Updated Date (LUD)* used as the fallback for backward compatibility.
- Dedicated fallback for zero values - Define separate fallback logic when no values exist, instead of treating "zero" and "more than one" the same. In other words, you can apply different fallback logic when no values are available versus when multiple values exist.
- Added optional `ignoreCase: true` parameter for Min, Max, Frequency, and Value-Based Priority strategies to treat case-variant values (e.g., "USA" vs "usa") as equal. Defaults to `false` for backward compatibility.

## Keep traffic private on Azure

You can now route tenant traffic privately over Azure Private Link — extending our zero-exposure model from AWS to Azure. With this capability, create a Private Endpoint in your Azure Virtual Network (VNet) and connect to Reltio using the provided service alias.

All traffic stays entirely within Azure's private IP space in the same region, never touching the public internet — enhancing security, reducing attack surface, and simplifying compliance with internal and regulatory policies.

## Native LCAs deprecation

The native **Lifecycle Action** (LCA) feature will be deprecated in a two-phase process starting with the current 2025.2 Release. Native LCAs are customer-authored code components that run within Reltio's environment.

| What you need to know | What you need to know |
| --- | --- |
| Why are we deprecating it? | Running customer-authored code in Reltio's environment can lead to performance and security issues. Native LCAs also require manual engineering review before deployment, which creates delays and increases operational overhead. |
| What do you need to do? | Plan to migrate your native LCAs to **cloud-native functions** like AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, or Azure Functions. Reltio will provide scripts, documentation, and support to help with this transition. |
| Find out more | [Native LCA deprecation – Oct 2025 and Aug 2026](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/deprecation-notices-at-a-glance/native-lca-deprecation--oct-2025-and-aug-2026?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs) |

## Run LCAs in Azure

You can now build, deploy, and run Lifecycle Actions using serverless Azure Functions — all from your own Azure environment. Just like with AWS and Google Cloud Functions, you have full control over deployment, authentication, logging, and scaling — without relying on Reltio to manage or deploy your logic.

# Key features and enhancements

Learn about key new features and enhancements introduced in this 2025.2 release.

The following features and enhancements are included in this release to improve product capabilities, configuration workflows, and overall user experience.

## Reltio AgentFlow™

**AgentFlow™** is Reltio's new agentic operations suite that delivers prebuilt AI agents designed to automate data governance and business workflows. These agents operate on governed, real-time data in your Reltio tenant and inherit access, policies, and lineage from the Reltio Context Intelligence Platform ™.

Each agent is designed to execute a specific task, from match resolution to workflow load balancing. AgentFlow ensures security, auditability, and role-based access (RBAC) by default, requiring no setup or scripting to get started.

The following agents are part of this release:

- **Data Explorer**: Explore entity profiles and relationships in read-only mode
- **Resolver**: Analyze and resolve potential duplicates automatically with optional external enrichment
- **Work Assigner**: Redistribute workflow tasks across active stewards to maintain balanced queues
- **Address Enricher**: Validate and correct entity addresses using trusted external sources
- **Product Recommender**: Suggest personalized products using customer profiles, interactions, and graph signals
- **Unmerger**: Automatically audit and unmerge records that were incorrectly merged

Whether triggered by real-time events or scheduled jobs, the integration synchronizes the creation, update, merge, and deletion of entity records across platforms. Support for reference lookups and relationship sync keeps commercial data accurate, timely, and compliant.

## Unstructured Data Studio

**Reltio Unstructured Data Studio** unlocks the value of unstructured data, which lets you ingest documents like PDF, extract entities with AI, and map them directly into Reltio's intelligent data graph.

Here are its key features:

- **AI-powered extraction**: Ingest individual file(s) from sources like Google Drive, or S3. Automatically extract relevant entities, so data stewards can focus on reviewing, not retyping.
- **Mapping to Reltio profiles**: Extracted data is intelligently mapped to Reltio's data model.
- **Approval workflows**: All changes are routed through configurable approval steps through workflows.
- **Document lineage**: Source files can be stored and deep-linked within profiles when needed, supporting both regulatory and operational traceability.
- **Batch or real-time processing**: Run document processing on a schedule or trigger it on demand.

## Reltio Identity Builder™

**Reltio Identity Builder™** links individual records to a curated U.S. referential dataset to increase match accuracy, reduce duplicates, and support enrichment with attributes like verified contact information, aliases, birth date, deceased indicator and other marketing signals.

This capability runs continuously in the background and is delivered through a governed Data Tenant subscription. You'll receive only the matched results, not the full referential dataset. It complements existing rule-based and AI-based matching without requiring rule rewrites.

**FERN** now supports multiple matching modes to give you greater control and precision when resolving your data. You can choose from three pre-configured modes — **Enhanced Discovery**, **Data Steward**, and **Full Mode** — to tailor match behavior to specific business needs.

## Observability Hub

Built on Reltio Context Intelligence Platform ™, the **Observability Hub** gives you live operational insights and an intuitive interface for independent monitoring of platform performance, usage, and data quality. Observability dashboards display API throughput, error rates, and latency using RED metrics. Historical views help you compare trends over time and detect performance changes. You can drill down by user, API, or request type to identify problematic workloads and resolve issues faster. Role-based access supports operations, governance, and analytics teams.

Observability APIs will be available soon enabling customers to integrate Reltio platform metrics into their observability tool of choice, such as Datadog, Splunk, Grafana Enterprise, or any system that supports ingestion of time-series data.

# 2025.2 major Release Notes

> **Section:** Reltio > What’s new and notable? > What's new at a glance > Release Notes at a glance > 2025.2 Release Notes


**Source:** https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/release-notes-at-a-glance/2025.2-release-notes/2025.2-major-release-notes?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs


Learn about new features and enhancements introduced in this 2025.2 release.

Reltio powers trusted data for every user, system, and decision. As a cloud-native, AI-enabled master data management (MDM) platform, Reltio unifies core data across silos to deliver a real-time, complete, and trusted view of customers, products, suppliers, and more.

The Reltio Data Cloud brings together a set of interoperable, role-driven products that accelerate time to value:

- 

  **Reltio Entity Resolution** applies AI and LLM-based models to match and merge records across disparate systems, creating a universal ID with high precision and speed.
- 

  **Reltio Multidomain MDM** delivers scalable master data management across multiple domains, with built-in governance, survivorship, reference data management, and relationship views.
- 

  **Reltio Intelligent 360** goes beyond MDM to add segmentation, derived attributes, interaction management, and conversational data exploration via Reltio Intelligent Assistant (RIA).
- 

  **Reltio AgentFlow™** enables autonomous AI agents built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, empowering secure, key data stewardship, governance automation, and conversational interaction across roles.
- 

  **Reltio Observability Hub** provides real-time dashboards and API access to monitor performance, usage, and health of your Reltio tenant, enabling proactive operations, faster issue resolution, and Service Level Agreement (SLA) visibility.
- 

  **Reltio Unstructured Data Studio** extracts insights from PDFs and other documents using workflows, enabling entity recognition and enrichment in Reltio with minimal manual effort and scalable automation.

Together, these products support efficiency, compliance, and AI powered experiences with real time governed data.

## Control visibility of Entitlement View with customer specific API flag

The Entitlement View is shown or hidden based on your entitlement model: Standard, Usage, or Pooled. If you are a Standard customer, the view is enabled by default. If you are a Usage or Pooled customer, it remains hidden until your entitlement logic is implemented.

To manage access, submit a support ticket. See topic [Get help in Support Portal](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-in-the-box/whats-in-the-box-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-at-a-glance/technical-assistance-operations/get-help-in-support-portal?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

A Reltio Support person will use the backend API `POST /api/v1/compliance/{customerId}/entitlementView?enabled=true` to enable the view for a specific customer. You can verify entitlement access by calling the GET API `/api/v1/compliance/isAllowedForEntitlementView?customerId={customerId}`, which returns true or false.

## Reltio Address Cleanser update – September 2025

You can use `CassUseUSPSPreferredCity` to return USPS-preferred city names, or `CassPreserveAlias` to retain alias street names when using CASS for address verification. For more information, see [Reltio Address Cleanser update - Sep 2025](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/platform-changes-at-a-glance/reltio-address-cleanser-update---sep-2025?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).

## Disable external streaming without disrupting data pipelines

A new `streamingAPIEnabled` parameter in tenant configuration allows you to disable external streaming — such as SFDC or DnB — without interrupting internal pipelines like Grouping and DataPipeline. This is especially useful during bulk loads, debugging, or maintenance windows.

Default value is `true`. Available in **Console > Tenant Management > Tenant Configuration > MessageStreaming**.

For more information, see [Message streaming](https://docs.reltio.com/en/developer-resources/data-integration-apis/data-integration-apis-at-a-glance/events-api/message-streaming?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)

## Address Auto Complete and Contact Verification updates paused

The **Address Autocomplete** and **Email and Phone Verification** features were previously listed in the 2025.2 release (see [2025.2 major Release Notes](https://docs.reltio.com/en/reltio/whats-new-and-notable/whats-new-at-a-glance/release-notes-at-a-glance/2025.2-release-notes/2025.2-major-release-notes?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs)) but have been temporarily withdrawn as we continue fine-tuning them for a better experience.

## Track Interaction updates

We are introducing an enhancement that allows easier visualization and management of interaction data when updates are managed through append transactions . This feature allows users to track changes to interactions (e.g. hotel reservation updates) without modifying existing records — ensuring history is preserved and the latest state is always visible. Here are some key highlights:

- **Append only model** - Each update creates a new interaction with a unique URI
- **GroupKey support** - Use a simple attribute as the primary key and set it in the data model
- **Streamlined UI** - Shows only the latest interaction, and logs previous versions

For more information, see [Append interactions using Groupkeys](https://docs.reltio.com/en/applications/hub/profiles-at-a-glance/profile-perspectives-tabs/profile-perspectives-navigation/interactions-perspective/interactions-perspective-navigation/append-interactions-using-groupkeys?utm_source=ai-corpus&utm_medium=markdown&utm_campaign=reltio-ai-ready-docs).
